title: 2027 Finance Degree Apprenticeship
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth.

Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership.

You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities.

  • Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements.

  • Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines.

  • Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data.

  • Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time.

Eligibility Requirements

This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care.

This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here.

  • Academic Qualifications: You will have either:

  • A degree qualification

    OR

  • You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date

+ 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths

Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway.

  • Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail.

  • Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you!

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Account Director (Life Science)
descriptionHtml:
Experience Without Limits
Come shape the future of brand experience.

At Jack Morton, we design and build head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients unlock the full value of experiences by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one. We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

The Account Director is responsible for leading a portfolio of client accounts, acting as the senior strategic partner and primary point of contact. This role drives the overall client relationship, ensuring delivery excellence, commercial performance, and long-term growth. The Account Director will translate client objectives into innovative event strategies, lead cross-functional teams, and maintain the highest standards of service, promote creativity, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Own, develop, and execute strategic relationship plans for Executive Leadership, C-Suite, and key stakeholders across assigned accounts.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic counsel, insight, and creative innovation that supports their business objectives and elevates partnership value.
  • Lead the creation and execution of robust client retention and growth strategies, ensuring year-on-year account stability and expansion.
  • Develop and implement tailored business development plans within existing client portfolios, identifying opportunities for new services and revenue streams.
  • Champion the agency’s full-service offering, ensuring amplification services (digital, creative, production, engagement, etc.) are effectively positioned and integrated into client solutions.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Own the financial performance of allocated accounts, including revenue forecasting, gross margin delivery, and profitability targets.
  • Lead the commercial review process, ensuring accurate pricing models, transparent financial tracking, and proactive margin management.
  • Drive commercial excellence through regular analysis of client profitability, resource utilisation, and pricing initiatives.
  • Ensure internal CRMs, budgets, and commercial documentation are accurate, complete, and aligned with internal governance standards.

Client Delivery & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee delivery of all client Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring standards of excellence across all programs.
  • Provide senior oversight of project/account management teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest compliance and quality standards.
  • Partner with internal operations, compliance, and delivery teams to maintain robust governance frameworks.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to evaluate performance against KPIs, identify areas for improvement, and shape future strategies

New Business & RFP Management

  • In partnership with New Business Development, lead the strategic response and delivery of RFPs, proposals, and pitch presentations for assigned accounts and support new opportunities that IXM receive.
  • Contribute to the development of thought leadership, case studies, and credentials that reinforce the agency’s expertise within the LifeSciences sector.

People Management 

  • Develop, mentor and coach all direct reports ensuring monthly meetings to discuss progress and review development plans.
  • Oversee the development, mentoring and coaching of the wider team.
  • Working with the Associate Director Talent Management, monitor development plans for all team members considering:
  • Current skills analysis
  • Training needs analysis
  • Individual’s needs and desires
  • Development planning strategies
  • Lead on recruitment process, interviewing and selecting new team members.
  • Provide consistent leadership, motivation and direction to all team members.
  • Work with Executive Leadership to ensure all teams are consistently sharing best practice and delivering to Impact-XM standards at all times.
  • Management of direct report holidays and lieu days.
  • Oversee the management of wider team holidays and lieu days.

General

  • Monitor and review timesheet activity in Company time sheet system
  • Prepare monthly client project analysis to ensure team and recruitment costs are assessed against client budget.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8–10 years’ experience in client services, account management, or event strategy
  • Proven track record of managing global or multi-market client portfolios and developing long-term senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with demonstrable experience in budget management, margin optimisation, and pricing strategy.
  • In-depth understanding of industry compliance and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and fostering collaboration across operations, creative, digital, and production functions.
  • Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to influence at senior levels.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for growth, innovation, and service excellence.

Last but not least, we believe in diversity, equity and inclusion.

Jack Morton is an equal opportunity employer; we strongly value diversity at our companies. We do not discriminate on race, religion, color, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

How We Use AI in Hiring

Jack Morton uses AI tools to help organize applications, schedule interviews and summarize notes. AI does not make hiring decisions; every application is reviewed and every decision is made by our team. To opt out of AI review or request an accommodation, contact Job Accommodations 

We make our careers website accessible to any and all users. title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment.


Accountabilities:

As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers.

  • Deliver compelling presentations and value propositions that demonstrate how solutions can help customers investigate and disrupt criminal activities.

  • Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams.

  • Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a strong track record of selling SaaS solutions to public sector organizations across the DACH market. You should be comfortable navigating complex procurement processes, engaging senior decision-makers, and managing strategic opportunities with significant commercial value. The following qualifications are expected:

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and successfully close high-value, six- and seven-figure deals.

  • Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives.

  • Excellent storytelling abilities and the capacity to translate customer challenges into compelling value propositions.

  • Strong understanding of consultative selling, account management, prospecting, and strategic territory planning.

  • Knowledge of the cryptocurrency ecosystem and an interest in blockchain-related technologies, financial crime investigation, or digital asset intelligence.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving customer needs, and dynamic market conditions.

  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and ownership of commercial outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.

  • Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities, particularly when managing complex opportunities and multiple stakeholders.

    • Benefits:

You’ll report to Adrien Cannet, who leads the Account Executive team for the accountant channel. descriptionHtml:
At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together.

What We Do...

Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year.

That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still.

About the Account Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Germany!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success.   • Partner management – Work with local industry groups and travel associations to promote SiteMinder’s products and brand. Attend key functions and events, requiring occasional travel to client locations to attend meetings with relevant managers.

What you have...

title: Account Executive  - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

title: Account Executive, Europe
descriptionHtml:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As an Account Executive at Scarlet you will own deals from discovery to close by building relationships with regulatory and operations leaders. You will become a regulatory expert capable of meeting the complex needs of our customers. Your work will help ambitious medical technology companies bring safe products to patients sooner and drive Scarlet’s growth. This is a London-based role with a global reach.

What you'll be working on

The companies you'll be selling to are doing some of the most interesting work in healthcare right now. A few of the customers you'll be pointing prospects towards:

  • Floy certified three AI radiology devices under EU MDR, completed an ISO transfer and a scope extension, all in 16 weeks

title: Account Executive Nordics
descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You will report in to the VP EMEA.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required)

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required)

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

• Self-driven and at ease building a territory in a growing team.

Nice to have

• Experience in an early-stage or scale-up team in a new region.

Travel and location

• Based in the Nordics, ideally near Stockholm, Oslo, Copenhagen or Helsinki.

title: Area Medical Lead, North & Midlands
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

You own the clinical bar across the Neko clinics in the North and Midlands (currently Birmingham and Manchester).

That means every consultation in your area meets the same threshold of safety, quality, and member experience across your region. It means the clinical teams working with you are developing, not just performing. It means clinical issues are being seen and addressed before they show up in audits or member complaints. And it means the quality metrics for your region are known, owned and moving in the right direction. And it means clinical judgment shows up at the table when operational decisions are being made.

You'll partner closely with the UK Medical Director, who holds final clinical authority for the UK market, and operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager for your region who owns the operational side. The clinical health of the region is yours.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Hold the clinical standard across every site in your area

  • Manage and develop the clinicians in your region: performance conversations, development plans, coaching, and the honest feedback that turns good clinicians into great ones.

  • Ensure lead clinicians in your market(s) are performing excellently and that the clinical teams have the appropriate clinical escalation pathways in place.

  • Support clinical hiring for your area against defined criteria, and partner with the Training and Education team to close training gaps as they emerge.

  • Own the review and closure of clinical incidents and near-misses in your area, making sure learnings are actually applied, not just documented.

  • Own the quality metrics for your region: accountable for performance against Neko's medical quality goals at area level, including scan quality (perfect scan score), member follow-up quality and timeliness (perfect follow-up score and follow-up SLAs), clinical safety (Northstar Clinical Safety score) and clinician summary quality and timeliness. Review the data with your Area Clinic Manager each week and month, trace variation to root cause by site and clinician, set improvement actions, and report progress and risks to the UK Medical Director.

  • Operate in true dyad partnership with the Area Clinic Manager: co-owning quality, member experience, and business goals, attending and contributing to Weekly and Monthly Business Reviews, and bringing clinical input into operational decisions before they're made.

  • Round your sites regularly to observe, support, and listen, surfacing what's working so it can spread, and what isn't so it can be addressed.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with the GPs, NHS trusts and private specialist clinicians who receive Neko referrals, monitoring referral quality and addressing breakdowns quickly.

  • Know the UK regulatory landscape: CQC registration and inspection standards, GMC/NMC professional standards and revalidation, NHS and GP referral pathways and obligations, and UK-specific clinical rules, and flag emerging risks before they become problems.

  • Lead or participate in clinical pilots as required - defining success, capturing learnings, and documenting outcomes so the rest of the company can learn from your region.

What We're Hiring For

  • Holds the Bar at Scale. You're the kind of clinical leader who can make sure every consultation feels the same regardless of site or clinician, not by micromanaging, but by setting a clear standard, coaching to it, and noticing when it drifts. You're rigorous without being rigid.

You represent Neko credibly because you're a credible clinician yourself. People in the local medical community know your name, and when you flag something, they take it seriously.

  • 4+ years of medical leadership experience in the UK health system (NHS and/or private sector), including direct management of clinicians.

Preferred

  • Experience in preventive care, tech enabled healthcare or longitudinal care models.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
descriptionHtml:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance

Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
What you'll do
  • Support the GTM team to drive pipeline and closely monitor performance on the team’s target
  • Identify and build targeted account-based audiences based on specific criteria:
  • Intent signals/Insights (Job Offers, Fundraising Announcements, New Sr. Leadership...)
  • Verticals (Scale-ups, Retail, Financial Services...)
  • Work closely with all North America GTM teams: Sales, Partners, Marketing, RevOps…
  • Develop and launch creative Outbound campaigns (email/LinkedIn …) to create memorable sales experiences and drive pipeline
  • Gather customer and market research to identify relevant patterns and produce relevant audiences and messaging (persona, industries, specific business use cases...)
  • Participate in tech projects including AI & automation processes & tools to support the GTM team

    • Who you are
  • French native, strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience in Business Development or Marketing
  • Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, Zapier or n8n
  • Ideally end-of-studies internship
  • Curious and interested in learning about Growth, Business Development, and Sales Operations
  • Proactive personality with attention to detail Metrics-driven mindset, with critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Creative & Builder mindset - we always think about new ideas to drive revenue

    • What we offer
  • The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family
  • Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility
  • Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France
  • High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

    • How we work
  • Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet
  • Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community
  • Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission
  • Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
  • Champion our Customers: We lead with empathy, solve what matters, and deliver clarity in a complex world to make our Customers heroes in their organizations

This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially. Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. title: Business Director [9mth  FTC]
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Business Director do at WPP Production?

WPP Production requires an experienced Business Director to lead an exciting global account in the luxury / optical sector through a period of positive transformation.

The successful candidate will bring a proven track record of winning new business, strong relationship-building and team leadership skills, and the gravitas and credibility to inspire confidence across clients and colleagues alike.

You'll focus on implementing more automated, agile and technology-enabled production processes while ensuring uninterrupted delivery of the existing scope. You'll optimise ways of working, revise commercial models, and introduce + implement new technologies that meet client needs by partnering with commercial, operations, language, QC, and martech teams to deliver innovative solutions that guarantee client satisfaction for years to come.

The Role

  • Partner with commercial, ops, and solution design teams to shape practical proposals that improve account sustainability and increased value for the client (perceived and concrete / tangible)
  • Lead the account's transformation to deliver more automated, nimble, agile, cost effective, and technology-enabled production solutions
  • Assess current processes and ways of working, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality, and develop a clear plan for change
  • Maintain uninterrupted, high-quality delivery of the existing scope throughout the transformation, while simultaneously demonstrating consistent and rapid progression toward new and improved capabilities and ways of working
  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and internal teams, aligning priorities and maintaining confidence throughout periods of change
  • Lead, motivate and develop the account team, creating clarity around roles, priorities and expected outcomes

Experience

  • Proven track record as a Business Director / experienced Senior Account Director in an integrated or production agency environment (or equivalent)
  • Demonstrable experience of successfully leading and securing scope extensions and responding to complex RFPs / client pitches to secure new business wins
  • Experience leading business or operational transformation across production processes, workflow management, automation, and AI-powered asset creation
  • Proven ability to optimise processes and ways of working while maintaining reliable day-to-day delivery
  • Experience managing senior client relationships and successfully influencing a range of internal and external stakeholders
  • A track record of leading and developing high-performing, multidisciplinary teams

Persona profile

  • Strong interpersonal, communication, problem-solving, commercial, influencing, and negotiation skills
  • A true relationship builder who is able to inspire confidence, build trust, and handle difficult conversations with tact, diplomacy, empathy, and positivity to drive satisfactory outcomes for all parties
  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour that brims with gravitas
  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, highly matrixed agency environment
  • Strategic and action-oriented, with the drive and capability to convert ideas and conversations into clear, achievable actions and outcomes
  • Resilient, adaptable and composed when managing competing priorities or uncertainty. Able to navigate ambiguity and make informed decisions based on sound business acumen and experience
  • Solid understanding of production, creative development, localization, and quality assurance processes across key channels including print, digital, video, social, broadcast, etc.
  • Clear understanding of international brand challenges and requirements and the marketing technology landscape

#LI -HYBRID

#LI -RH1

Why work here:
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. With access to diverse projects, global career opportunities, and the backing of WPP's unmatched network, this is a place where you can grow your skills, make real impact, and create work that performs for every audience, across every channel, at every moment.

Inclusion and Impact
WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Data
We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment. When you click the "Submit Application" button at the bottom of this page, this will send all the information you have added to WPP Production. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy statement. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: Business Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Engineer C2

Team: Product & Tech Business Operations

Salary: £45,600 - £57,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Business Operations

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work inthe UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you'll do

You'll own and evolve the technical systems that power P&T Business Operations — Jira architectures, data pipelines, dashboards, and integrations with enterprise platforms. You identify where operational capability could be stronger, scope those opportunities, and design and build solutions in collaboration with the Business Operations Manager. You approach problems with an AI-first mindset and make technical decisions with clarity about trade-offs.

  • Own and evolve the standardisation of Jira and other Kaluza data systems. Configure, extend, and redesign them to support increasingly complex business operations.

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and dashboards that turn raw operations data into clear signals for decision-making. Explore where AI agents and autonomous systems can streamline operations.

  • Identify opportunities for new capabilities (better delivery planning data & tooling capabilities, improved management insights solutions, plugging into adjacent Kaluza products) and design and build solutions, aligned with the direction from the business operations manager who will lead the product & delivery enablement side of things

  • Connect and integrate internal products and platforms — Workday integrations, locally-built internal tools, and other solutions. Make recommendations on what to build, integrate, or take over — clearly articulating trade-offs, impact, and delivery path.

  • Anticipate security, compliance, and regulatory constraints upfront. Navigate Kaluza's systems to unblock delivery quickly.

  • Spot when something's off — in the data, in a process, or in a tool — and fix it before it becomes someone else's problem.

  • Iterate on our operational tooling continuously, testing new approaches early and sharing what you learn openly with the team.


What you'll bring

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • 3–5 years building and maintaining operational tooling — not just writing code, but owning what you ship.

  • Strong Jira expertise (including JQL) and Confluence; comfortable configuring them for complex portfolio structures.

  • Experience with APIs/integrations and data exchange, SQL + basic scripting, BI tools, AI tools and automation.

  • Experience building data pipelines or automated workflows with practical understanding of keeping them reliable at scale.

  • Confident in identifying improvements and implementing them independently. You break down ambiguous problems, scope solutions, and drive delivery without constant prompting. You don't wait to be told what's next.

  • Comfortable with data analysis, ambiguity, and working in scaling organisations where processes and systems need to grow as fast as the people using them.

  • You navigate Kaluza's systems to move fast. You share progress openly and communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • You're the kind of person who spots a constraint, maps it back to its root cause, and builds a fix (or identifies where a temporary workaround is needed, whilst you work on a fix). You set a high bar for your own work and raise it over time, and you're not satisfied leaving a system in a worse state than you found it.

  • You work openly by default: you share progress, flag blockers early, and communicate what's working and what isn't without waiting to be asked. People across the organisation find it easy to understand what you're doing and why.

  • You're genuinely curious about new tools and approaches — especially AI — and you actively bring others along by sharing what you've tried, what landed, and what didn't. Learning in the open comes naturally to you.


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: CAM-/CNC-Programmierer 5-Achs Fräsen (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
PolyTALENT besetzt diese aktualisierte Position für einen wachstumsstarken Industriepartner in Hamburg. Gesucht wird ein erfahrener CAM-Programmierer / CNC-Programmierer

Unternehmen

Das Unternehmen fertigt anspruchsvolle Bauteile für Luft- und Raumfahrt, Defence und Energie und verbindet moderne 5-Achs-Bearbeitung mit Robotik, Software und skalierbaren Produktionsstandards.

Benefits

  • Schlüsselrolle im Standortaufbau mit viel technischem Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Arbeit an hochpräzisen sicherheitskritischen Bauteilen in einem zukunftsstarken Umfeld

  • Zugang zu modernen 5-Achs-Werkzeugmaschinen und wachsender Automatisierung

  • Einfluss auf Programmierstandards, Werkzeugbibliotheken und Best Practices für mehrere Standorte

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigung, Industrial Engineering und Softwareentwicklung

  • Option auf Equity-Beteiligung in einem international skalierenden Produktionsnetzwerk

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung, Simulation und Optimierung von CAM-Programmen für 3- und 5-Achs-Fräsbearbeitung

  • Programmierung von CNC-/NC-Toolpaths für komplexe Bauteile mit engen Toleranzen

  • Auswahl von Werkzeugen, Schnittdaten und Spannkonzepten für Aluminium, Stahl, Titan und Inconel

  • Einrichten, Einfahren und Prozessfreigabe neuer Teile bis zur stabilen Serienfertigung

  • Analyse und Reduzierung von Zykluszeiten sowie Verbesserung der Maschinenauslastung

  • Aufbau von Programmbibliotheken, Templates und Fertigungsdokumentation

  • Interpretation technischer Zeichnungen inklusive GD&T und toleranzkritischer Merkmale

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung von Vorrichtungs- und Spannstrategien

  • Unterstützung von NPI / Neuteileinführungen von der Zeichnung bis zur robusten Produktion

  • Fachliche Rückmeldung zu DFM-Themen an interne Teams und Kunden

  • Zusammenarbeit mit dem Softwareteam zur Verbesserung von Datenerfassung, Planung und Automatisierung

  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau des Standorts, bei Inbetriebnahmen und bei der Definition robuster Fertigungsabläufe

Profil

  • Mehrjährige Praxis als CAM-Programmierer (m/w/d), CNC-Programmierer (m/w/d), NC-Programmierer (m/w/d) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle der Zerspanung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen CAM-Systemen, z. B. hyperMILL, Mastercam, Siemens NX oder vergleichbar

  • Erfahrung in der 5-Achs-Fräsbearbeitung, idealerweise auch in der simultanen 5-Achs-Bearbeitung

  • Praxis an hochwertigen CNC-Maschinen, z. B. Hermle, DMG Mori oder vergleichbaren Anlagen

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung bei engen Toleranzen im Bereich von ±0,01 mm oder feiner

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für Vorschübe, Schnittgeschwindigkeiten, Werkzeugstandzeiten und Spanntechnik

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Programme nicht nur erstellen, sondern Prozesse auch an der Maschine absichern

  • Routine im Lesen komplexer Zeichnungen sowie in Revisionsstand, Dokumentation und Änderungsdisziplin

  • Wünschenswert sind Branchenkenntnisse in Aerospace, Defence oder anderen regulierten Präzisionsfertigungen

  • Pluspunkte sind Kenntnisse in Vericut, Messtastern, Palettensystemen oder EN 9100 / AS9100

  • Deutsch oder Englisch in einem Niveau, das eine sichere Abstimmung im technischen Produktionsumfeld ermöglicht

title: CDI - Manager Product Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux.

Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API.

  • Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent.

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

What you will need to be successful

Du willst an Projekten mitwirken, die die Energie- und Infrastruktur von morgen gestalten? Bei uns arbeitest du an anspruchsvollen Infrastrukturvorhaben entlang des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – von der strategischen Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Mit analytischem Denken, einem Gespür für Kundenbedarfe und Interesse an technologischer Transformation trägst du dazu bei, komplexe Projekte effizient, nachhaltig und zukunftsorientiert voranzubringen.

Deine Mission
Als Consultant Infrastructure & Capital Projects bist du Teil anspruchsvoller Infrastrukturprojekte. Du bringst dich schnell in Projektteams ein, übernimmst früh Verantwortung und unterstützt dabei, tragfähige Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln und erfolgreich umzusetzen. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dein Arbeitsumfeld aktiv mit – mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Diese Position ist in Voll- und Teilzeit möglich.

Das erwartet dich

  • Treibe die Transformation von Infrastrukturprojekten voran
    Gemeinsam mit deinem Team unterstützt du Kund:innen dabei, komplexe Infrastrukturprojekte ganzheitlich zu transformieren – von der strategischen Konzeption bis zur operativen Umsetzung. Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale, entwickelst pragmatische Lösungsansätze und schaffst messbaren Mehrwert durch Effizienzsteigerung, Digitalisierung und moderne Projektsteuerung.
  • Übernimm Verantwortung in Infrastrukturprojekten
    Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei der Steuerung anspruchsvoller Infrastrukturvorhaben und arbeitest aktiv an der Strukturierung, Priorisierung und Umsetzung zentraler Projektanforderungen mit. Dabei schaffst du Transparenz in komplexen Zusammenhängen, bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und übernimmst früh Verantwortung für qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse.
  • Begleite die Umsetzung vor Ort beim Kunden
    Du begleitest Kund:innen dabei, komplexe Infrastrukturprojekte mit hoher Steuerungsqualität erfolgreich umzusetzen. Dabei unterstützt du den Aufbau wirksamer Projektstrukturen, stärkst das Stakeholder-Management und hilfst Projektteams, auch in dynamischen Umfeldern konsistent starke Ergebnisse zu liefern.

Qualifikation

Darauf freuen wir uns

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.
  • Idealerweise konntest du bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen durch Praktika oder Werkstudententätigkeiten in der Beratung oder in Infrastrukturprojekten sammeln.
  • Du überzeugst durch eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit und bewegst dich sicher im Austausch mit Kunden und Projektteams.
  • Du hast Lust, dich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, denkst analytisch und bringst die Flexibilität mit, die ein dynamisches Beratungsumfeld erfordert.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – jeweils mindestens auf C1-Niveau.

Benefits

Deine Vorteile bei Accenture

  • Ein flexibles Arbeitsmodell, bei dem du die Möglichkeit hast, mobil zu arbeiten, ein eigenverantwortliches Überstundenkonto zuführen und deine Arbeitszeit aktiv selbst zu gestalten
  • Zugriff auf umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zu den neusten Technologie- Trends sowie Soft Skills, damit du immer up-to-date bleibst
  • Diverse sowie gleichberechtigte Teammitglieder liegen uns sehr am Herzen und um den Team-Zusammenhalt zu stärken, fördern wir regelmäßig Events und Veranstaltungen für dich und dein Team
  • Ein attraktives und marktkonformes Vergütungspaket, welches du durch individuelle Zielerreichung selbst gestalten kannst
  • Weitere Benefits, die unserer Meinung nach zum Standard gehören, aber nicht vergessen werden sollten: Mitarbeitenden-Rabatte, die Möglichkeit ein Job-Rad oder einen PkW zu Firmenkonditionen zu leasen, das Partizipieren an unserem Aktienprogramm, Versicherungs- und Altersvorsorge-Möglichkeiten und noch vieles mehr…

Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied

Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Und wenn die unterschiedlichsten Talente, Stärken und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entsteht etwas Großartiges: Ideen, die in der Welt etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir bei Accenture auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung. Schaffe dir ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du aufgehst. Mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen. Mit einem Workload, der zu dir passt. Und mit einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und persönlich wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere. Wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst.

Dein Kontakt

Du hast Fragen? Dann wende dich gerne an Jil Felderhoff. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

title: Creative Strategist & Producer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We’re building the healthcare workforce for tomorrow. Our AI receptionist Luna is already automating patient communication in medical practices today. As the market leader in German and Austrian dentistry, and with major funding under our belt, we’re now taking the next big step: new medical specialties, new countries, new products. As Creative Strategist & Producer, you own the ads that introduce medical practices to Luna, from idea to final cut, and build the in-house creative engine that keeps leads coming in every week.

Why praxipal? The shortage of skilled professionals is the biggest challenge in our healthcare systems. Tens of thousands of positions remain unfilled each year, and demographic shifts are only making things worse. Medical practices rely on our AI receptionist Luna to reduce staff workload and keep care accessible for everyone. We’re growing at record speed and closed a $6.7M seed round with HV Capital.

We are a tech-driven company that deliberately relies on a small, talent-dense team. What defines us is the speed and intensity with which we work, but just as important to us is our team spirit. That’s why we come into the office every day: to connect, learn from one another, and grow together.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience producing content for paid social, ideally performance ads for Meta, at a startup, an agency or as a freelancer

  • Hooks, angles and conversions matter more to you than likes, and you know why an ad works or doesn’t

  • A feel for what makes organic content work on Instagram and LinkedIn, and how it differs from ads

  • End-to-end skills: script, shoot, edit and design, including confident handling of cameras, lighting and audio so every shot looks and sounds professional

  • A results-driven mindset: you measure your work by its impact, and you consistently deliver high-quality content at

  • A portfolio that shows what you can do, ideally with numbers to back it up

  • A hands-on mentality: no task is too unglamorous for you

  • Fluent German and English, both written and spoken

What You’ll Do

In short: You’ll develop and produce the ads that drive praxipal’s growth, plus the organic content that builds our brand, and build our in-house creative production from the ground up along the way.

  • You shape our creative strategy: you dig into our target groups, competitors and ad performance and turn your insights into ideas, hooks and angles that stop practice owners mid-scroll and get them to reach out

  • You write scripts for video ads, from UGC-style to testimonials to product demos

  • You plan and run shoots: with customers in their practices, with our team and with creators

  • You edit videos and design static ads yourself, fast and at high volume

  • You deliver fresh creatives and variations every week so our campaigns never run out of steam

  • You systematically test hypotheses together with our performance marketing team, analyze what works and turn the learnings into the next round of creatives

  • You keep a close eye on the latest content marketing trends, formats and platform features and bring fresh ideas into our creatives before everyone else does

  • You also produce organic content for Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels, often by repurposing material from your ad shoots

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive base salary plus participation in our VSOP program

  • Real impact: your creatives directly determine how many practices we win each week, and you see the results in real time

  • Creative freedom: you help build our creative production from scratch and grow into more responsibility at an exceptional pace

  • Professional gear: if you don’t have your own, we provide high-quality equipment for shooting, lighting and audio

  • Unparalleled learning opportunities at the frontier of AI and healthcare

  • Work alongside a strong, motivated team with ample growth opportunities

  • Urban Sports Club membership

  • Lunch subsidy via Lunchit and daily team dinners covered by the company

  • Regular team events and offsites with the wider praxipal team
