title: ERP Key User / Senior ERP Consultant (microtech büro+) – Auftragssachbearbeitung & Einkauf (m/w/x)
descriptionHtml:
BITTE KEINE PERSONALVERMITTLER

Erobere mit uns gemeinsam Zukunftsmärkte, entdecke neue Technologien und wachse in eine echte Schlüsselrolle mit zukünftiger Führungsverantwortung hinein!

Bei der Epotronic GmbH verbinden wir marktführende Hersteller wie DJI und technologische „Hidden Champions“ mit der Praxis. Wir sind spezialisiert auf den Vertrieb und Einsatz von High-Tech-Drohnen, Vermessungs- und Inspektionsgeräten (LiDAR, GNSS), Roboterhunden, sowie passender Software. Zu unseren Kunden zählt die Bundesrepublik Deutschland, internationale Großkonzerne, Behörden, Universitäten, Ingenieurbüros und Spezialbetriebe.

Der Erfolg gehört dir: Unser Umsatz stieg von 2 Mio. € im Jahr 2021 auf 9 Mio. € im Jahr 2023 bevor wir uns komplett von unserem Investor trennten. Wir arbeiten seit dem unabhängig ohne Investoren im Hintergrund – unsere Ziele setzen wir uns selbst.

Um dieses Wachstum auf das nächste Level zu heben, suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit.

Deine Rolle & Perspektive bei uns

Du bist kein reiner Verwalter und auch kein reiner IT-Theoretiker, sondern ein Hands-on-Allrounder der das operative Tagesgeschäft im Griff hat und dieses mit ausgeprägtem Prozessverständnis selbstständig optimiert. Du übernimmst schrittweise zentrale Aufgaben direkt von der Geschäftsführung, umunsere Systemlandschaft rund um microtech büro+ aktiv weiter zu entwickeln. Perspektivisch baust du deinen Bereich eigenständig aus und wächst, sofern gewollt, in die Führungsverantwortung (Teamlead IT / Operations / Kaufmännische Leitung) hinein.

So teilt sich dein Alltag auf:

1. Operatives Tagesgeschäft – Auftragssachbearbeitung, Einkauf, Produktmanagement, Buchhaltung (ca. 50 %):

  • Auftragssachbearbeitung: Ganzheitliche Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Steuerung von Kundenaufträgen (vom Angebot über Auftragsbestätigung und Lieferschein bis hin zur Rechnungsstellung oder -korrektur).

  • Einkauf & Beschaffung: Operative Bestellabwicklung, Überwachung von Lieferterminen, Artikelstammdatenpflege sowie Kommunikation mit unseren internationalen Herstellern und Logistikpartnern.

  • Vorbereitende Buchhaltung: Schnittstellenarbeit zur Finanzbuchhaltung (Rechnungsprüfung, Belegkontrolle und Klärung von Differenzen).

→ sinkt perspektivisch in 2-3 Jahren auf ca. 30%

2. ERP-Betreuung & Prozessoptimierung in microtech büro+ (ca. 30–40 %):

  • System-Verantwortung: Du betreust, leitest und optimierst unsere Prozesse im Warenwirtschaftssystem microtech büro+ als interner Key User / Prozess-Leads. Bei steigender Skalierung wird sich deine Verantwortung um den Trainerjob erweitern.

  • Automatisierung & Struktur: Du identifizierst manuelle Zeitfresser im Alltag und stellst sie durch clevere Workflows, Regeln, eigene Tabellenansichten, Filter und angepasste Drucklayouts ab. Du kennst dich idealerweise schon mit GraphQL aus oder den alten COM und EDI-Schnittstellen.

  • Schnittstellen-Management: Du überwachst und optimierst den Datenfluss zwischen büro+, unserem Online-Shop, dem CRM-System und der Buchhaltung. Export und Import sind dir vertraut.

→ steigt perspektivisch mit zunehmender Skalierung

3. Zukunfts- & IT-Projekte (ca. 10–20 %):

  • Mitarbeit an neuen strategischen und technischen Projekten.

  • Weiterentwicklung unserer internen IT-Infrastruktur, Digitalisierungsthemen und direktes Sparring mit der Geschäftsleitung.

  • Natürlich kannst du dich auch bei Produktthemen einbringen, damit der Spaßfaktor noch weiter steigt.

Qualifikation – Das bringst du mit

  • Praxishintergrund: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (z. B. Groß- und Außenhandel, Industriekaufmann/-frau) oder ein betriebswirtschaftliches/technisches Studium mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung in der Auftragsabwicklung und/oder im Einkauf.

  • ERP-Expertise: Fundierte Erfahrung als Key User, Super-User oder intensiver Anwender in microtech büro+ (oder tiefgreifende Prozess-Erfahrung in einem vergleichbaren ERP-System wie JTL, Sage, Haufe X360, weclapp o. ä. mit dem Willen, dich rasant in büro+ einzuarbeiten).

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du packst im Tagesgeschäft (Aufträge, Einkauf, Belege) selbstverständlich und fehlerfrei zu, denkst aber bei jedem Klick darüber nach, wie man den Prozess morgen noch besser machen kann.

  • Technik- & IT-Affinität: Verständnis für Schnittstellen (Shop, CRM, DATEV/Buchhaltung), Datenstrukturen und moderne IT-Tools.

  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (für die Kommunikation mit internationalen Herstellern).

  • Persönlichkeit: Gewissenhaft, lösungsorientiert, durchsetzungsstark und bereit, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Wachstumschancen: Du übernimmst direkt Verantwortung von der Geschäftsführung. Mit dem Ausbau deiner Rolle und des Teams steigen auch deine Führungsverantwortung und dein Gehalt spürbar an.

  • Freiheit & Flexibilität: Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, ein professionelles und flexibles Arbeitsumfeld (mobiles Arbeiten 1–2 Mal wöchentlich möglich) und Kernarbeitszeiten rund um die Mittagspause.

  • Zukunftstechnologien: Direkter Einblick in die rasant wachsenden Branchen Robotik, Drohnentechnologie, Reality Capture und KI-Datenerfassung inklusive regelmäßiger Einblicke durch unsere Hersteller.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Ein schlagkräftiges, internationales und hilfsbereites Team ohne Konzernbürokratie – gute Ideen für Prozessverbesserungen setzt du bei uns sofort um.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt?

Dann überzeuge uns mit einer modernen und schlagfertigen Bewerbung! Nenne uns darin mindestens ein starkes Argument für deine ERP-/Prozess-Kompetenz oder eine konkrete Idee/Erfahrung, wie du in der Vergangenheit einen Ablauf im System optimiert hast

  • Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse / Zertifikate

  • Rückfragen gerne telefonisch unter +49 (0) 211 59892931

title: Expert Support Technique et Comptable
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ?
Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ?
Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable.

Ton rôle
Tu prends en charge les sujets les plus complexes remontés par nos utilisateurs et nos équipes Support.
Ton objectif : comprendre l’origine des problèmes, qu’ils soient comptables, fonctionnels ou techniques, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes Produit et Tech.
Tu joueras un rôle clé entre les utilisateurs, le Support, les développeurs et les équipes Produit.

Tes missions

  • Investiguer des bugs, anomalies et problématiques comptables ou fonctionnelles.

  • Reproduire les problèmes rencontrés et en identifier la cause.

  • Qualifier les incidents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.

  • Échanger avec les développeurs et le Produit pour transmettre des analyses claires et exploitables.

  • Utiliser les outils d’investigation disponibles : logs et SQL simple.

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ;

  • sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

Process de recrutement :

  • Premier échange un/e recruteur - 30 min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec deux membres de l’équipe - 60 min

  • Entretien avec le Manager direct - Thibault et Viviane (Associate Team Lead Technical Support) - 60 min

  • Entretien avec Thomas (Team Lead Technical Support) - 45 min

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. title: Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN
descriptionHtml:
Alassio renforce son équipe Métier et recrute son ou sa Expert(e) Métier Paie & DSN !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride

  • Équipe : Métier

  • Expérience : 5 à 8 ans en paie, dont une expérience chez un éditeur de paie ou en MOA paie

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Un logiciel de paie ne vaut que par la justesse de ses règles métier. Qu'il vienne de la roadmap ou d'un cabinet, chaque sujet doit être analysé finement avant d'être développé : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et sur la DSN. Avec l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets et l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes, ces sujets se multiplient.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu es l'analyste métier de référence de la paie chez Alassio : tu décortiques les sujets complexes et tu transformes un besoin métier en solution fiable, puis tu t'assures que ce qui est livré fonctionne vraiment pour nos cabinets. Tes sujets d'analyse viennent de deux sources : la roadmap du produit paie, et les cas les plus complexes que nous remontent nos cabinets.

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Analyser les sujets métier de la roadmap : règles applicables, cas limites, impacts sur les bulletins et la DSN, notamment pour l'extension d'Alassio à de nouveaux régimes

  • Investiguer les cas les plus complexes escaladés par le support : écarts de calcul, anomalies et rejets DSN, régularisations ; identifier la cause et la bonne réponse (bug, évolution ou paramétrage, ce dernier étant pris en charge par l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie)

  • Formaliser tes analyses en spécifications fonctionnelles pour l'équipe Tech

  • Construire les cas de test avant chaque mise en production

  • Porter des sujets de bout en bout, du cadrage à la mise en production, avec l'équipe Tech

  • Prototyper si besoin avec des outils d'IA pour valider une approche

  • Faire de chaque analyse une source d'amélioration : transformer les irritants récurrents en sujets produit, priorisés avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), et enrichir la documentation fonctionnelle et la base de connaissances

 

🔁 Tes rituels

  • Les kickoffs des sujets que tu portes ou sur lesquels tu interviens

  • Un triage hebdomadaire avec Huy Anh, l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie et le support : remontées des cabinets, corrections, priorités produit

  • Le demo day de toute l'équipe, chaque vendredi midi

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Tu travailles au quotidien avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier), l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie, le support, l'équipe Tech et Ludivine (Resp. Juridique)

  • Outils : Alassio, Linear, Notion, Intercom, outils d'IA

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises le produit, le moteur de calcul et le circuit du support ; tu analyses tes premiers cas remontés par les cabinets et ta première spécification est relue avec Huy Anh

  • À 3 mois : tu portes un sujet de la roadmap de bout en bout (spécification, cas de test, recette), l'analyse des remontées des cabinets est systématisée et tu partages ton rapport d'étonnement

  • À 6 mois : tu es la référence métier de la squad Prod ; les sujets arrivent mieux spécifiés aux développeurs, avec moins d'allers-retours, et les irritants des cabinets se résolvent plus vite

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en paie, dont une expérience de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie ou en maîtrise d'ouvrage (MOA) paie

  • Une pratique avancée de l'analyse fonctionnelle : spécifications, cas de test

  • Maîtrise de la DSN : structure, contrôles, anomalies et rejets, régularisations

  • Solide culture des règles de paie en environnement multi-conventions

  • Une écriture claire et structurée, compréhensible par un développeur comme par un gestionnaire de paie

Un plus :

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Expérience d'un outil de gestion de projet produit (Linear, Jira ou équivalent)

  • Aisance avec les outils d'IA ou de prototypage

 

💎 Qualités

  • Le réflexe d'aller au fond d'un sujet avant d'écrire une ligne de spécification

  • L'autonomie pour porter un sujet de bout en bout

  • La capacité à faire dialoguer le métier et la tech

  

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Appel d'introduction avec Hector (COO) : 30 min

2️⃣ Entretien métier avec Huy Anh (Resp. Métier) et Hector : 45 min

3️⃣ Cas pratique en direct avec Huy Anh et un développeur : à partir d'une remontée réelle d'un cabinet, qualifier le besoin et poser les grandes lignes d'une spécification et de ses cas de test : 1 h

4️⃣ Rencontre avec l'équipe : 1 h

👉 Le processus se termine par des prises de référence.

  

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission unique

Être au cœur du produit paie d'un logiciel nouvelle génération, voir tes analyses devenir des fonctionnalités et rester au contact direct des cabinets.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération fixe de 60 à 75K€ selon l'expérience + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (titres-restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel informatique haut de gamme (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏡 Télétravail régulier possible

  • 🤓 Offsites d'équipe réguliers (un par trimestre en moyenne)

 

Certaines personnes hésitent à postuler quand elles ne cochent pas toutes les cases. Si tu hésites, postule quand même : on en parlera volontiers.

 

➡️ Prochaines étapes

Si la mission te parle, postule via le formulaire de candidature. Pour toute question, écris à Pour en savoir plus sur Alassio : alassio.fr

title: FEA Simulation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

The role
As an FEA Simulation Engineer, you join the early team and own the structural integrity of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. Through static and dynamic FEA, you make sure our structures withstand real-world loads while pushing every gram toward best-in-class lightweight targets. Your sign-off is the final gate between a design and its release to hardware.

Your profile

Key responsibilities

  • Structural Integrity: Lead static and dynamic FEA on load-bearing structures, delivering sign-offs based on well-founded assumptions rather than padded safety factors.

  • Lightweight Optimization: Drive topology and parametric optimization to minimize mass within the safety margin, validated by physical testing.

  • Dynamic & Fatigue Analysis: Model impact, vibration and cyclic loading to predict failure modes before they appear in testing.

  • Design Collaboration: Partner with the design engineers from the earliest concept stage, turning simulation insight into load-path-aligned design decisions rather than after-the-fact checks.

  • Methods & Standards: Establish the organization's FEA methods, material data and sign-off standards, and correlate them continuously with test results.

Who we are looking for
We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

Must have

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated FEA/structural simulation in high-performance robotics, aerospace or automotive engineering, with a track record of sign-offs on structures that shipped.

  • FEA Mastery: Expert level in Abaqus or comparable tools for static, dynamic, modal and fatigue analysis - able to defend every modeling assumption behind a sign-off.

  • Materials & Methods: Solid knowledge of metals and composites, topology optimization and multi-body dynamics.

  • Test Correlation: Proven experience correlating simulation predictions with physical test data.

  • CAD Fluency: Comfortable in CAD to translate findings directly into design iterations.

  • Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge mechanical, electrical and software teams, and you iterate until predicted and measured failure modes match.

Nice to have

  • Explicit Dynamics: Experience with drop and impact simulation.

  • Thermal-Structural Coupling: Experience combining thermal and structural results.

  • Scripting & Automation: Python or similar to automate pre- and post-processing.

  • Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.

Why us?

  • The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.

  • Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.

  • Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.

  • Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.

We are an equal opportunity employer.

title: Field Engineer (m/w/x)
descriptionHtml:

title: Financial Data Sales Associate, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
The financial industry is growing at a record pace, but our data providers are still stuck in the past — with cumbersome onboarding processes, complicated APIs, slow infrastructure, and expensive licensing costs.

Databento is the market data platform for modern finance. The company provides real-time and historical data across futures, options, and equities through a unified API. By owning the entire market data stack end-to-end, Databento is the first platform of its kind to combine the performance and reliability demanded by the world's leading trading firms with a dramatically simpler developer experience. Our team includes alumni of Two Sigma, Citadel Securities, Flow Traders, IMC, Tower Research, Jump Trading, HRT, Jane Street, and SIG.

Responsibilities

As a Financial Data Sales Associate based in the EMEA region, you will oversee the full scope of sales at Databento. This includes the following:

  • Own the technical sales process, from answering technical customer inquiries and providing data samples to solving data-related issues that our customers raise.
  • Create common examples and use-cases with market data, with examples in Python, C++, and/or Rust.
  • Gather customer feedback, testimonials, case studies, and more.
  • Establish and maintain accurate, timely, and documented forecasting and record-keeping procedures, keeping our CRM up-to-date and organized.
  • Build a network of executive relationships across the industry and with key partners and customers.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify potential business opportunities and adapt sales strategies accordingly.
  • Collaborate across teams to align sales efforts with overall company objectives and ensure a seamless customer experience.

Desired Qualifications

The ideal candidate has experienced the end-to-end sales pipeline, including top-of-funnel, upselling, channel sales, customer success, and forecasting. Below are other skills that we look for:

  • Understand and communicate with our user base of developers and quants.
  • Experience with quant trading and market microstructure.
  • Extreme attention to detail and record-keeping, as well as the ability to automate processes in HubSpot.
  • Professional communication skills that align with the tone of an institutional financial product.
  • White-glove management of the sales cycle with continual buy-in from the customer, discovering the user's pain points, signs of friction, being honest when our product isn't the best fit, not being too pushy or salesy, and knowing when to continue vs. back off.
  • Readiness to work within a startup environment with limited resources and personnel.
  • As a bonus: Active usage of GitHub, knowledge of enough C++, Python, and/or Rust to help answer client inquiries.

We offer health, dental, disability, and life insurance benefits, as well as 401(k) matching for full-time employees. We accommodate 100% remote work, with teammates living around the globe and paid in their local currency.

The base salary range for this role is $80,000–$155,000, benchmarked to Tier 1 locations in each country. Total compensation may also include bonuses, commissions, and equity, depending on the role.

Notice about phishing scams

Be cautious of phishing scams impersonating Databento that offer fake job interviews and request purchases. Official emails come only from us.greenhouse-mail.io (our ATS). Any other domains (e.g., databento-careers.com, databento.online) are fraudulent.

We comply with federal, state, and local nondiscrimination laws in every location where we operate. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave, compensation, and training. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.
  • Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.
  • Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.
  • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field
  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)
  • Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level
  • Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field
  • Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on
  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments
  • EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools
  • UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments
  • Experience with datalinks and radio systems
  • Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers
  • German language skills

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Pension plan 
  • Extended social security package 
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

STRATOS builds the commercial digital twin that large industrial companies run on. We work with global B2B companies to synchronize strategy and execution and ensure commercial success is driven by potential, not gut feel or old data. STRATOS is a category-defining, rapidly growing startup, profitable and majority founder-owned with our Series A still ahead of us, funded by high-profile investors (e.g., Accel) and trusted by 15 global industrial leaders and Fortune 500 customers. Our software integrates complex datasets into a unified solution, combining deep data integration, best-in-class workflows, and cutting-edge generative AI.

The role

descriptionHtml:

Healthcare is broken. Das wollen wir ändern, und dafür suchen wir Dich!

Über MediPulse

Ärzt:innen führen ihre Praxis wie ein mittelständisches Unternehmen: mit Personal, Investitionen und Kreditlinien. Gesteuert wird sie trotzdem im Blindflug. Das Honorar der KV steht erst Monate nach Quartalsende fest, die BWA kommt Wochen zu spät, und der Überblick entsteht mühsam in Excel. Engpässe zeigen sich erst, wenn sie längst eingetreten sind.

Das ändern wir. Als Founders Associate Intern arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern an den Themen, die MediPulse gerade am stärksten nach vorn bringen. Du arbeitest täglich mit Alex und Kolja, unseren Gründern. Beide kommen von McKinsey; Kolja kennt die Praxis von innen: Im chirurgischen MVZ seines Vaters hat er von Anfang an die betriebswirtschaftliche Seite verantwortet.

descriptionHtml:
Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid

Type: Full-time

About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

title: Founding Counsel (Europe)
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Firstwork is building the operating infrastructure for the global frontline workforce. We're backed by Google's AI Fund, Y Combinator, Earlybird and more.

We help companies hire, onboard and operate workers across multiple countries, combining software and applied AI across identity, compliance, right-to-work, onboarding and workforce operations.

Today, Firstwork supports workforce operations for over 150,000 workers per month across approximately 80 countries. As we expand further across the UK and Europe, we are looking for a Legal Counsel to become our first dedicated in-house legal hire.

This is not primarily a contracts role.

You will work directly with the founders, product and operations teams on the regulatory questions that determine where and how Firstwork can operate, how our products should work, and how we scale responsibly across jurisdictions.

What you’ll own

European expansion & regulatory approvals

Lead and coordinate the regulatory work required for Firstwork to enter and operate in new European markets.

You will:

  • Build and maintain a clear view of the regulatory requirements applying to Firstwork across jurisdictions.

  • Lead registrations, filings, licensing and other regulatory work associated with market entry and ongoing operations.

  • Work with local counsel where specialist jurisdictional advice is required, while progressively bringing knowledge and capability in-house.

  • Turn external legal advice into clear business decisions, operating processes and product requirements.

  • Help determine where Firstwork can operate, under what structure and with what controls.

Workforce regulation

Own our understanding of the rapidly evolving regulatory environment surrounding frontline, contingent and platform work.

This will include areas such as:

  • Worker classification and employment status.

  • Right-to-work and immigration compliance.

  • Temporary staffing and employment-business regulation.

  • The EU Platform Work Directive and related national legislation.

  • Emerging regulation affecting digitally mediated and AI-enabled workforce operations.

You will assess how these developments affect Firstwork, our customers and our products, and work with product and operations teams to translate legal requirements into scalable workflows and controls.

Product & regulatory counsel

Work alongside the teams building products involving identity, employment eligibility, workforce compliance and applied AI.

Rather than reviewing products after they have been built, you will help shape them.

You will:

  • Advise on the regulatory implications of new products and capabilities.

  • Help establish frameworks for launching products across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Identify issues early and develop pragmatic approaches that allow us to move quickly while managing regulatory risk.

  • Translate complicated legal requirements into rules that software and operational teams can actually implement.

External counsel & regulatory operations

Firstwork will continue to use specialist external counsel where it genuinely adds value. You will make that network substantially more effective.

You will:

  • Manage relationships with specialist counsel across European jurisdictions.

  • Scope questions tightly and challenge advice where appropriate.

  • Determine what expertise should remain external and what Firstwork should progressively bring in-house.

  • Maintain the regulatory documentation, evidence and audit trails supporting our operations.

  • Build systems that allow us to reuse legal and regulatory knowledge rather than repeatedly solving the same problem.

As our first dedicated legal hire, you will also support the wider business on commercial, corporate and other legal matters where appropriate, while continuing to use specialist counsel for areas requiring deeper expertise.

Who we’re looking for

You will most likely be a UK-qualified solicitor with several years of strong post-qualification experience, although we care substantially more about judgement, trajectory and ownership than an exact PQE number.

You might currently be:

Experience: Typically 2-5+ years PQE ; flexible to an extend

  • At a strong law firm and looking for substantially more ownership and proximity to the business.

  • In-house at a technology, marketplace, employment, staffing or other regulated business.

  • Working in an environment where technology, regulation and international expansion intersect.

You should have:

  • Excellent legal training and strong analytical judgement.

  • Experience in regulatory, employment, immigration, technology or another relevant practice area.

  • The ability to independently research an unfamiliar regulatory question and turn it into a practical recommendation.

  • Confidence working directly with founders, senior executives, product teams and external counsel.

  • Excellent written communication and an instinct for making complicated legal issues understandable.

  • A commercial mindset: the objective is not simply to identify risk, but to determine how the company can operate responsibly and effectively within it.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the legal function is being built alongside the business.

You do not need to already be an expert in every jurisdiction or regulatory regime we encounter.

We are looking for someone with the legal foundations, intellectual curiosity and judgement to become one.

Why Firstwork

  • This is an unusually broad legal role.

  • You will join as Firstwork’s first dedicated in-house legal hire and work directly with the founders and senior leadership.

  • You will have substantial ownership over our European regulatory strategy, work alongside leading external counsel across multiple jurisdictions, and help shape products used to bring hundreds of thousands of people into work.

  • The company is expanding quickly, and the legal function will expand with it.

 

For the right person, this is an opportunity not simply to take an in-house legal role, but to help build the legal and regulatory function of a global technology company from the ground up.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Founding Customer Success Manager - DACH
descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager at Heidi Health, you’ll be the bridge between technology and care - helping hospitals, clinics, and clinicians across Germany adopt and love Heidi.

You’ll manage the full customer journey for both public and private hospital deployments, ensuring seamless implementation, strong clinician engagement, and measurable impact on patient care.


This role is ideal for someone with a medical background (e.g. former doctor, nurse, or allied health professional) who’s excited to drive digital transformation in healthcare.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value.

  • Lead onboarding & training: Lead onboarding of new customers from planning, training through to go-live, delivering seamless integrations into customer workflows.

  • Track and improve metrics along customer journey like time-to-first-value and early activation.

  • Drive strategic adoption: Develop and execute tailored adoption plans to maximise user engagement and satisfaction, enhancing the continued love for Heidi among clinicians.

  • Enhance Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risks and work cross-functionally to deepen product engagement.

  • Customer advocacy: Build executive-level relationships and become the voice of the customer internally, advocating for their needs and priorities and showcasing wins.

  • Continuous engagement: Deliver value at every touchpoint through proactive check-ins, success planning, and education strategies. Think and act strategically to scale your impact.

  • Resolve operational blockers: Collaborate with product, engineering, and support teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.

  • Feedback insights: Gather and share insights to influence product development and feature prioritisation.

What you'll need

  • 2+ years in a customer success role at a SaaS company, with proven ability to own the full lifecycle

  • A romantic streak about software. You believe great products can transform someone's day.

  • Familiarity with Germany’s healthcare ecosystem (both public and private).

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effortlessly set and manage expectations with customers and cross-functional teams.

  • Highly organised and can confidently manage multiple projects and competing priorities, while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

  • Self-starter with a bias for action, comfortable navigating fast-paced and ambiguous environments.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude is more important than experience - if you are hungry, competitive, and motivated, with a knack for problem solving and relationship-building, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.
We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

title: Full Stack Developer
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

You build the experience traders see when they work with Leonidas AI: a streaming, branching conversation where agents answer with live price tiles, charts, ARB analysis and sources, inside our app and wherever traders already work, such as Microsoft Teams and Excel. You own features end to end, from the backend-for-frontend to the component in a trader's hands.

This is a full stack role for the agentic era. The interface is no longer a set of fixed screens: it renders what an agent decides to show, as it thinks. You make that feel instant, trustworthy and easy to act on.

What you will do

  • Build agentic UI. Streaming chat, typed blocks parsed mid-stream, tool-call status, branching threads, and dashboards that turn an answer into something a trader can watch.

  • Own the BFF. Route handlers, auth, persistence of conversations and blocks, and the contract between the front end and the agent runtime.

  • Surface data people trust. Show source and as-of time on every number, with charts and tables that make curves and ARBs easy to read.

  • Work with the people who use it. Pair with designers, product and SMEs, and talk to traders to see where the experience breaks.

  • Use AI to build faster. Prototype with Claude Code, write tests that keep pace, and help raise our bar on testing beyond the UI.

What you bring

  • Proven experience building production web applications across front end and back end.

  • Strong TypeScript, React.

  • Experience with real-time UIs: streaming (SSE or WebSockets), optimistic updates and resilient reconnects.

  • Backend skills in Node.js or Python, with Postgres and API design (REST, tRPC or GraphQL).

  • A product eye: you sweat latency, empty states and the detail of a chart.

  • Good testing habits: unit, integration and end-to-end.

Nice to have

  • Built UI for LLM products or integrated with an agent backend.

  • Data visualisation for time series or financial data.

  • Design systems and monorepos (Nx, Storybook).

  • Microsoft Teams or Office add-in development.

Our stack for this team

TypeScript · React · tRPC · Kotlin · Postgres · Redis · Python · AWS

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

WERDEN SIE NICHT NUR GESCHÄFTSFÜHRER – WERDEN SIE UNTERNEHMER!

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

title: Go-To-Market Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Growth at CFO Insights

The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?

Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.

The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.

You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.

If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.

Why CFO Insights

CFO Insights is Northern Europe’s largest CFO forum and aims to connect and develop CFOs, finance leaders, and tomorrow's innovators by addressing the issues of the future CFO. We are connecting more than 11,000 professionals from more than 15 countries.

CFO Insights is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

  • Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
  • Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
  • Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
  • Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
  • Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.

What you will do

Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:

  • Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
  • Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
  • Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
  • Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
  • Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
  • Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.

What we expect from you

  • 1 to 3 years of experience
  • Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
  • A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
  • Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
  • Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
  • Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
  • A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
  • Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise

Practical details

Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

title: Google-Ads Account Manager | Fokus E-Commerce (m/w/d) | Frankfurt am Main
descriptionHtml:
Hey, wir sind Hitaj Digital!

Wir sind Wachstumspartner für ambitionierte E-Commerce Brands & Onlineshops mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main. Diesen Onlineshops helfen wir dabei, profitabel auf 7-bis 8-stellige Jahresumsätze zu skalieren mit Hilfe von Google Ads/Google Shopping usw.

Wir bieten unseren Kunden eine einzigartige Partnerschaft, welche

  • Unser firmeneigenes, signalbasiertes PMAX-System nutzt, das gezielt die passenden Neukunden anspielt, kombiniert mit
  • Einem tiefen Verständnis im E-Commerce, der unseren Kunden hilft, gezielt höher zu ranken, als die Konkurrenz & dabei mehr Umsatz zu erzielen und
  • KI für die Kampagnenstrategie & Analysie, sowie Skalierung von E-Com Brands nutzt.

Hast du Bock auf...

  • direkten Kundenkontakt mit jungen Gründern und Online-Shop-Inhabern?
  • Vollzeit im Office in wunderschönen Frankfurt am Main
  • Gutes Gehalt und Möglichkeiten zu wachsen finanziell, als auch persönlich
  • Faires Bonussystem für Vertragsverlängerungen, exzellente Performance als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit und dem Erfolg der von dir betreuten Kunden?
  • Marketing-Strategien für Kunden zu bauen und für unsere Kunden klare Skalierungs-Strategien im Google Ads Account umzusetzen?

Nice, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden dabei zu wachsen und eine Revolution im E-Commerce Space einzuläuten. Dafür geben wir täglich 110%.

**Falls du ebenfalls Bock auf High Performance hast, dich persönlich weiterentwickeln willst und dein volles Potenzial ausschöpfen willst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Solange du Ergebnisse lieferst, hast du volle Freiheit und Vertrauen deinen Alltag so zu gestalten, wie es dir passt.

**

UNSERE WERTE

  • Kundenerfolge. Wir glauben daran, das beste für die Kunden auch das Beste für uns ist. Daher bekommt jeder Kunde bei uns genau die Unterstützung, die er braucht, so lange bis er wirklich erfolgreich ist.
  • Einfachheit. Weniger ist mehr. Unwichtiges weglassen. Denn Komplexität im privaten und beruflichen Leben ist einer der größten Störfaktoren für die meisten Unternehmer.
  • Hohe Standards. Großartig ist nicht gut genug. Wir glauben daran, dass wir die Branchen-Standarts neu definieren können und uns nur mit dem besten Ergebnissen zufrieden geben sollten.
  • Ehrlichkeit & Transparenz. 100% ehrlich und transparent sein - auch wenn es weh tut. Denn das bringt unsere Kunden und uns selbst langfristig am weitesten.
  • Spaß. Das was wir machen sollte Spaß machen, ob alleine oder im Team oder im Ad-Account.
  • Zahlen, Daten, Fakten. Wir entscheiden analytisch & zahlenbasiert und nicht Ego- oder Emotionsgetrieben.
  • Ergebnisse. **Nur das Ergebnis zählt. Letzendlich ist es "egal", was du genau machst, haupsache es bringt das Ergebnisse, was du dir erhoffst & die Performance stimmt.

WICHTIG: Ohne vorherige Erfahrung in Google Ads bitte nicht bewerben!**

Aufgaben

Als Google Ads Account Manager bist du maßgeblich an unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase beteiligt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um transformativen Mehrwert zu schaffen und gleichzeitig Systeme aufzubauen, die Shopumsätze skalieren.

Deine Aufgaben: Client-Success-Management & Ads-Account Management

  • Übernimm die Verantwortung für diverse Onlineshops, die heiß drauf sind zu wachsen und gib ihnen durch Account-Optimierung, Accountabilty und Strategie-Entwicklung alle Tools mit an die Hand, die sie dafür brauchen.
  • Kickoffs durchführen: Nach Durchsicht einer detaillierten Bestandsaufnahme definierst du eine individuelle Roadmap, die mit höchster Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeit zum Ziel führt.
  • Accountability Calls: In wöchentlich stattfindenden Calls analysierst du die aktuellen Engpässe, beantwortest spezifische Fragen und definierst die nächsten Optimierungsschritte für die Kunden.
  • Google Chat Support: Zwischen Accountability und Themen-Calls unterstützt du die Onlineshops via Google Chat mit hilfreichen Antworten, Loom-Videos oder schickst Screenshots von Erfolgen im Ads Account.
  • Das Endergebnis: Du liefererst konsequent messbare Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden.

Google Ads Account Management

  • Du betreust in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Spezialisten-Team die Google Ads Accounts von Online-Shops aus diversen spannenden Nischen & Branchen.
  • Account-Strategie & Kampagnen-Setup: In täglichen Meetings tauschen wir uns darüber aus, was aktuell funktioniert, analysieren Ad-Accounts und du erhältst wertvolles Feedback zu deinen betreuten Accounts.
  • Du bist im Austausch mit unserem Sales-Team, hast eine Übersicht über die aktuellen Kunden und bietest rechzeitig Verlängerungen an & Schritte zur Optimierung.

Copywriting

  • Entwickle professionelle Google Ads Copywriting-Fähigkeiten auf Expertenniveau
  • Du optimierst die Ads, Sitelinks, PMAX Kampagnen & Such-Kampagnen von unseren Kunden.

  • Lerne, Signale für Google Ads Kampagnen zu erkennen und zu nutzen

Kurzum: Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die Online-Shops individuell zu betreuen, Engpässe zu lösen und die Performance im Google Ads Account hoch zu halten. Dies geschieht durch 1:1-Calls, Projektmanagement, Account-Management und Google-Chat-Support.

Qualifikation

title: Graduate Conference Production Executive at United Media
descriptionHtml:
Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you gain a tremendous amount of responsibility? Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with young, motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Production Executive.

About us

United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. To this date, we have organically launched six companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

As our Production Executive you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You'll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You'll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Leading research to identify rising trends that will define the future of the industry.
  • Creating comprehensive content programs with formats that produce best-in-class conference experience and engagement.
  • Maintaining and developing long-standing and fruitful relationships with industry-leading companies, new and existing senior executives across the globe.
  • Preparing and aligning with such key senior executives at leading companies for the delivery of top quality content and interactions on stage.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: Graduate Customer Care Advisor (Kent)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys

You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

  • Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

  • Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

  • Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

  • Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

  • Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

  • Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training resources and AI systems

  • Keeping up with product, system and process changes, acting on coaching and feedback, and sharing what you learn with colleagues


What we're looking for

Essential

  • Clear, empathetic communication, both spoken and written. You can adapt to the person in front of you and explain something complicated in plain English

  • The ability to learn quickly, pick up new products and procedures, and act on coaching

  • Good organisation: you can manage several tasks at once and follow a structured process accurately

  • Sound judgement, and the willingness to speak up when a customer isn't getting a good outcome

  • Comfort with digital tools and picking up new technology, including AI-driven platforms

  • Availability to work from our Chatham office three days a week and two weekends a month (where you will work from home)

Nice to have

  • Experience in a contact centre or another customer-facing role, particularly in financial services would be a definite plus but it is not essential for this role.

  • A habit of spotting where a process could work better and suggesting how


Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.Interview process

  • Nachhaltigkeit als Kern: Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.

  • Lerne & wachse: Profitiere von internen Lern- & Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.

As our Graduate Partnership Manager, you get the unique opportunity to be a key player in building the greatest global conferences by providing you with exceptional training and products. title: Grafik-Design + Social Media - Praktikum (w/x/m) Orientierung oder Pflicht
descriptionHtml:
Mit Geschmack, Gespür und Grafikverstand.

Grafik ist deine Passion. Du siehst, was gut ist. Du hast Geschmack. Design liegen Dir im Blut und du stehst auf die schönen Dinge? Du bist online zu Hause, weißt wie die Kanäle ticken und möchtest dein Wissen und deine Leidenschaft endlich professionell ausleben?

Dann melde Dich gerne bei uns, bitte unbedingt mit ein paar Arbeitsproben, auf die du stolz bist.

Design liegen Dir im Blut. Oder Du bist auf dem besten Weg zum Coder? Erste Seiten sind bereits online? Lass sehen, wir sind gespannt!

Social Media: Dein Herz schlägt für Posts, Gestaltung, Text und Analysen. Du sprichst die Sprachen der verschiedenen Kanäle und kannst 1A Rechtschreibung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben?

Mach die Dinge hübsch. Mit Verstand. Und mit Power.

Von der Website über Logos bis zum Magazin – und zwischendurch noch ein paar knackige Slides und clevere Social-Media-Post. Du unterstützt und entwickelst: Konzept, Ideen, Text. Du filmst, fotografierst, machst Bildbearbeitung. Und du wendest an: als planen, posten, schalten, auswerten, berichten.
Das volle Programm, ohne Rücksicht auf Vorlieben: mal verspielt, mal streng, mal laut, mal leise. Hauptsache gut.

KI? Nutzt Du mit – nicht blind, aber clever. Für schnellere Ideen, bessere Moodboards oder das erste Wording zum Visual.

Wir sehen KI als Werkzeug. Den kreativen Kopf dahinter ersetzt sie nicht – und genau der bist Du. Deswegen schick uns keine Bewerbung, die die KI für dich geschrieben hat, sondern eine ganz persönliche.

Qualifikation

Was Du mitbringen solltest?

Bring mit, was Du kannst: Ausbildung, Studium, Quereinstieg – alles gut. Hauptsache Talent. Ohne das wird’s schwierig.

Du brauchst kein abgeschlossenes Designstudium, aber ein gutes Auge, Lust auf Gestaltung und den Anspruch, Dinge besser zu machen.

Gute Laune hilft. Energie auch.

Und Deutsch? Muss sitzen. Mit Punkt, Komma und allem drum und dran. Auch, wenn Du nicht textest – wir lesen, was Du schreibst.

Benefits

Was Du bekommst?

Kaffee. Klar. Wasser und Obst auch. Und Müsli.

Dazu: spannende Kunden, echte Projekte und ein Team, das nicht nur nett tut, sondern wirklich nett ist. Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – mit Hirn, Herz und Haltung.

Homeoffice? Klar. In der Regel 2 Tage die Woche.

Und falls Du Awards magst: Uns wurden in den letzten drei Jahren fünfzehn Preise verliehen. Nicht, weil wir’s drauf anlegen. Sondern weil wir’s ernst meinen.

Zum Schluss noch das:

Wir emotionalisieren Unternehmen.

Wir beraten, gestalten, planen – entwickeln Strategien und Konzepte, die nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auch wirken.

Und wir begleiten unsere Kunden so lange, bis aus guten Ideen echte Ergebnisse werden.

Unsere Agentur? Mitten in Karlsruhe, in der Straße, wo sich Kunst, Kulinarik, Kultur und Kreativität treffen: die Waldstraße.

Super angebunden mit Bahn und Bus, gut erreichbar mit dem Rad, dem Scooter oder dem Auto – und einfach ein guter Ort zum Arbeiten.

Was Dich hier erwartet? Coole Kunden. Kreative Kolleg:innen auf Augenhöhe.

Und eine gesunde Mischung aus Präsenz und Homeoffice – aktuell zwei Tage die Woche remote.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich. Wirklich.

P.S.:
Bitte schau, dass deine Bewerbung einen CV, ein Portfolio, ein paar Zeugnisse und ein kleines Anschreiben beinhaltet.
