title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Dutch speaking/ Nederlandstalig)
descriptionHtml:
Over de rol 🎯

Als Senior Customer Success Manager bij DataSnipper zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten hun doelen bereiken met onze innovatieve, AI-gedreven oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de klantreis, van onboarding tot langdurige waardecreatie en retentie, en bouwt sterke relaties op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je helpt klanten sneller waarde te halen uit onze producten en draagt bij aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf.

Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om nauw samen te werken met professionals die de wereldwijde kapitaalmarkten draaiende houden, door uitzonderlijke service te leveren en een actieve en betrokken community voor onze klanten op te bouwen.

Word jij enthousiast van Customer Success en pak je graag zelf de regie? Dan horen we graag van je!

Over DataSnipper

Wij geloven dat vertrouwen essentieel is voor hoe de samenleving werkt. Elke dag vertrouwen we op informatie die onafhankelijk is gecontroleerd, van jaarrekeningen tot de producten die we kopen en de duurzaamheidsclaims van bedrijven. Achter dat vertrouwen staan audit- en financeprofessionals die bewijs onderzoeken, informatie verifiëren en organisaties ter verantwoording roepen.

Bij DataSnipper bouwen we AI-oplossingen waarmee deze professionals die beoordelingen kunnen maken. Met Alwin by DataSnipper, ons nieuwe agentic platform, nemen AI-agents audit- en financeprocedures van begin tot eind over, terwijl elke conclusie terug te voeren is op de bron. Zo houden professionals ruimte voor het oordeelsvermogen en de expertise die hun werk zo belangrijk maken.

Meer dan 600.000 professionals bij ruim 3.000 organisaties in 175 landen vertrouwen op ons platform. Daaronder vallen Fortune 500-bedrijven, overheidsinstanties en alle Big Four-accountantskantoren. Alleen al in 2025 leverde DataSnipper zijn klanten een productiviteitswinst op ter waarde van meer dan 1,4 miljard dollar.

Met een Series B-financieringsronde van 100 miljoen dollar onder leiding van Index Ventures, bij een waardering van 1 miljard dollar, leggen we een solide basis voor onze volgende groeifase. Als lid van 1% for the Planet kijken we niet alleen naar hoe snel we groeien, maar ook naar hoe we groeien.

Voor onze Customer Success-teams wordt het nu extra spannend. Alwin is net gelanceerd, de vraag groeit en we breiden uit naar nieuwe markten en segmenten. Met een product waar klanten al op vertrouwen, heb je de kans om echt je stempel te drukken op de volgende stap.

Wat ga je doen

  • Trusted Advisor zijn: Je bent een strategische partner voor belangrijke beslissers, zoals auditpartners en -managers, controllers, finance directors en IT-besluitvormers, en begeleidt hen bij de transformatie van hun organisatie met DataSnipper.

  • Business transformatie aanjagen: Je helpt klanten hun workflows en processen opnieuw uit te vinden en laat zien hoe de AI-mogelijkheden van DataSnipper meetbaar bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kostenbesparing en kwaliteit binnen audit en finance.

  • Strategische, consultatieve oplossingen bieden: Je denkt mee over de uitdagingen van elke klant en vertaalt dat naar praktisch advies, zodat zij hun audit- en financeworkflows optimaliseren en hun strategische doelen bereiken met DataSnipper.

  • Klanten helpen om meer waarde uit DataSnipper te halen: Je geeft uitgebreide trainingen, organiseert regelmatige Business Reviews en ontwikkelt succesplannen, zodat klanten de functionaliteiten van DataSnipper omarmen en aantoonbare waarde halen uit ons platform.

  • Hechte klantrelaties opbouwen: Je bouwt sterke, langdurige partnerschappen op basis van vertrouwen, diepgaand inzicht in de sector en oprechte betrokkenheid bij het succes en de resultaten van je klanten.

  • Over teams heen samenwerken: Je werkt samen met Product, Engineering, Sales en Solutions Engineering en deelt klantinzichten over workflowuitdagingen, use cases en technische vereisten om productinnovatie te stimuleren.

  • De stem van je klant zijn binnen DataSnipper: Je begrijpt de auditmethodologie, compliance-eisen en bedrijfsdoelen van je klanten goed en geeft feedback intern door, zodat DataSnipper antwoord geeft op echte behoeften uit de praktijk.

  • Strategische groei ondersteunen: Je signaleert en realiseert uitbreidingskansen binnen je portefeuille. Samen met Sales toon je de ROI aan, faciliteer je pilots en vergroot je de adoptie binnen teams en service lines.

  • Zorgen voor soepele technische implementatie en fungeren als platformexpert: Je ondersteunt klanten bij onboarding, inclusief setup, AI-configuratie en het op maat maken van workflows, en blijft up-to-date met het platform van DataSnipper, de AI-mogelijkheden en best practices voor automatisering.

  • Strategische sessies leiden: Je plant en faciliteert persoonlijke en virtuele sessies met audit- en financeteams om adoptie te stimuleren. Daarnaast deel je best practices voor een succesvolle transformatie en pak je uitdagingen aan die het klantbehoud in gevaar kunnen brengen.

  • Heldere succesplannen opstellen: Je maakt strategische roadmaps voor elke klant met transformatiedoelen, adoptiemijlpalen, uitbreidingskansen, engagementtactieken en succesmetrics.

  • Health en business impact monitoren: Je volgt en voorspelt belangrijke metrics, zoals gebruikersengagement, featuregebruik, geleverde bedrijfswaarde, uitbreidingskansen, retentierisico's en technische health-indicatoren.

Wat breng je mee

  • Customer Success-ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting of een andere customer-facing functie in B2B SaaS, met een goed begrip van de customer success-aanpak (onboarding, adoptie, verlengingen en uitbreiding).

  • Trusted Advisor-mindset: Passie om een strategische partner voor klanten te zijn, duurzame relaties op basis van vertrouwen op te bouwen en transformatie aan te jagen die uitzonderlijke waarde levert.

  • Focus op business transformatie: Aantoonbaar vermogen om klanten te helpen hun processen en workflows opnieuw te bekijken en te laten zien hoe technologie meetbare bedrijfsresultaten oplevert.

  • Verantwoordelijkheid en ownership: Een sterk gevoel van ownership en de drive om je vak te beheersen, initiatief te nemen en te zorgen dat geen details over het hoofd worden gezien.

  • Samenwerkingsgeest: Je werkt graag samen met andere teams en bouwt waardevolle partnerschappen op met klanten en interne stakeholders.

  • Flexibiliteit en groeimindset: Je leert snel en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving met een hoog tempo, waarin klantbehoeften en prioriteiten blijven veranderen.

  • Uitstekende communicatie: Professionele beheersing van het Engels en Nederlands is een must.

  • Auditachtergrond: Werkervaring binnen externe of interne audit of assurance is een pre.

Wat bieden wij

  • Je maakt deel uit van een van de snelstgroeiende, winstgevende unicorn-scale-ups van Nederland met wereldwijde impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights), zodat je meedeelt in het succes en de groei van het bedrijf.

  • Een pensioenregeling met een bijdrage van 6% bovenop je basissalaris.

  • 28 vakantiedagen per jaar (fulltime) voor een goede werk-privébalans.

  • Hybride werken, met minimaal 3 dagen per week op kantoor in ons dynamische kantoor in Amsterdam.

  • Dagelijks vers bereide lunches om je energiek te houden.

  • Een NS Business Card voor makkelijk reizen naar kantoor.

  • Een gestructureerd onboardingprogramma waarmee je een sterke start maakt, inclusief gereserveerde tijd om ons product en onze klanten te leren kennen voordat je écht begint.

  • Toegang tot doorlopende leer- en ontwikkelinitiatieven om je vaardigheden te laten groeien.

  • Werk samen met een levendig internationaal team verspreid over zeven kantoren wereldwijd.

  • Bedrijfsbrede events zoals DataSnipper GO, waar teams van over de hele wereld samenkomen.

  • Toegang tot Nilo, een platform voor mentale gezondheid en welzijn.

Sollicitatieproces

  1. Recruiter screening (30 minuten, online)

  2. Gesprek met de Hiring Manager (30 minuten, online)

  3. Assessmentgesprek (1 uur, op kantoor)

  4. Eindgesprek (30 minuten, online)

Bij DataSnipper geloven we dat goede ideeën voortkomen uit verschillende perspectieven, ervaringen en achtergronden. We streven naar een inclusieve werkplek en bieden elke kandidaat een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige sollicitatie-ervaring.

We selecteren op basis van competenties en prestaties, waarbij we kijken naar de vaardigheden, ervaring, het potentieel en de capaciteiten die relevant zijn voor de rol.

We verwelkomen sollicitanten ongeacht leeftijd, ras, etniciteit, nationaliteit, gender, genderidentiteit of genderexpressie, seksuele oriëntatie, religie, beperking of elk ander kenmerk dat jou maakt wie je bent.

Wat voor ons telt, is wat jij kunt toevoegen aan de rol, het team en DataSnipper.

descriptionHtml:
Industry leader? Well, how about an industry creator?! WalkMe, an SAP company, pioneered the world's leading Digital Adoption Platform, helping organizations navigate change across any application or system. title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

As a Senior Data Scientist in Credit Risk Modelling, you'll own credit risk and CLtV projects end to end – from spotting where the models hold the business back to getting the change live. The work ranges from keeping today's models accurate as conditions change, through incremental improvements, to research that could replace them.

You'll decide which problems to take on and how to solve them. With AI making prototyping cheap, more of the role now goes on research. You'll review other data scientists' modelling choices and coach newer members of the team.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Estimating the causal effect of amount, duration, and price on customer outcomes.

  • Unifying automated and manual models. Finding a principled way to put the two model families, which optimise slightly different objectives, on a common cost function.

  • IFRS accounting model. Developing a multi-stage model where recovery predictions feed back to improve the upfront loss estimates that International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) require.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Exploring whether a single, more general model could replace the separate credit and CLtV models.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Applied statistics. You have a background in statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar. You've applied it to commercial problems for several years, and chosen the methods yourself. You know when the data breaks a method's assumptions, and what that does to your answer.

  • Probabilistic reasoning. You quantify the uncertainty in each estimate, and treat calibration as a first-order concern.

  • Production ML. You've built supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere.

  • Project leadership. You've led modelling projects you spotted yourself, from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. Some of that work changed how a team models a problem.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it, and built tools or workflows your colleagues now use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You've worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Coaching. You've helped other data scientists improve their work, through review or mentoring.

  • Non-linear methods. You can think in terms of the cost function and inductive biases of your models.

  • Bayesian methods. You've used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You've modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £130,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Economist
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

Marketplace Highlights

  • Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

  • A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

  • Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Economist at Relay, you'll:

  • Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

  • Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

  • Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

  • Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

  • Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

  • Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

  • Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

  • Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

  • Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

descriptionHtml:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be our first Senior Engineer in ML, working alongside our Staff Engineer to help build the foundations from the ground up. There's no existing DS/ML team yet, so the two of you will shape it together, working closely with engineering, data, and product, who are already exploring how ML can be used in payments. There's a lot still to figure out and a lot to build. You'll work closely with your team's stakeholders to identify where ML can move the needle, and report to engineering leadership while that function takes shape.

What will you be doing?

  • Own the full lifecycle of ML-powered features within your initiatives - from independently researching and testing approaches through training, deployment and monitoring in production

  • Productionise smart routing decisions across the payment flow, building the ML infrastructure around them as you go - versioning, CI/CD, observability

  • Partner closely with product, data and engineering to turn promising use cases into shipped, measured outcomes

  • Bring a pragmatic, impact-first mindset to experimentation and model evaluation, rather than chasing the most sophisticated approach

  • Mentor other engineers as they pick up ML techniques, sharing how you think about tradeoffs and when to keep things simple

  • Talk directly to customers to validate ideas and pressure-test what you're building against real usage

  • Help set technical direction within your area, working with your team to prioritise the use cases worth pursuing

  • Establish patterns and practices that make ML work reliable and repeatable at Primer, building on foundations rather than defining them alone

What we're looking for

  • Senior experience in ML engineering, data science, or applied research, with real production deployments behind you (API, batch, or streaming)

  • You think statistically. You can design and run experiments and A/B tests, and report what the results do and don't show

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with ML libraries such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch or Keras

  • Solid grounding in modern software engineering, infrastructure and data tooling, and an understanding of the MLOps challenges across the full ML lifecycle. You don't need to have built a platform, but you know what one has to handle

  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning (multi-armed or contextual bandits, for example). Production experience with it isn't required, but you need to understand how it works and where it applies

  • Cloud experience — AWS preferred; GCP or Azure both fine

  • Exposure to payments or e-commerce is a plus, not a prerequisite - you'll build that domain depth on the job

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, in the problems and in the process. You can research, develop and productionise independently, and you'll help define how we work as you go

You may not like it here

  • You enjoy working in an office setting — we're remote-first, and always will be

  • You need a fully mapped-out roadmap before you start — we're building this function, and there is a lot yet to be defined.

  • You prefer handing models to another team to deploy and run.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Flexible holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

Explore your future career 🔭

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the Compliance strategy for our product engineering team. You are in charge of the performance, productivity, and innovation within this scope, ensuring that how clients and freelancers connect on Malt remains secure and trustworthy.

Today, our compliance ecosystem relies on robust KYC flows; tomorrow, we aim for a full AI-driven compliance experience. You play a crucial role in defining and implementing our technical strategy, driving project timelines, and fostering a high-performing and collaborative engineering environment. This is a hands-on leadership role where you are shaping the safety and integrity of the product experience that hundreds of thousands of freelancers rely on.


Key responsibilities ✨

  • Lead and inspire a high-performing team
    You will directly manage 1-2 cross-functional squads (8 to 15 engineers), ensuring a high-trust environment where talent thrives. This is a direct leadership role not a manager-of-managers position focused on setting clear direction, establishing strong team rituals, and maintaining high morale and engagement.

  • Co-build product and technical strategy
    Partner closely with the Product Director and Design Lead to co-create the long-term vision for the Compliance domain. You will translate complex regulatory requirements into a seamless user experience, ensuring that security measures never compromise platform usability. Together, you will balance technical debt, innovative features, and high-stakes roadmap priorities to deliver maximum value to our users.

  • Raise the bar on delivery and engineering excellence
    Own the delivery lifecycle by setting and tracking KPIs for velocity and quality. You’ll master the art of the trade-off, strategically balancing rapid delivery with long-term architectural health. By aligning team output with company strategy, you ensure every engineering effort drives maximum impact and scale.

  • Knowledge multiplier
    You will also contribute to the Engineering Manager Guild to scale these best practices and strategic frameworks across the entire organization

  • Own our compliance ecosystem
    You’ll be the primary tech point of contact for our external partners, from PSPs to legal data providers. You’ll ensure smooth integration, operational reliability, and long-term scalability in this core part of Malt’s product.


    • About you 🧑‍🚀

  • Hands-on Manager: You maintain your “technical mentorship” through code reviews and architecture discussions. You likely have a strong backend foundation (ideally in java/Kotlin) and a passion for engineering excellence.

  • Systems Thinker: You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments and excel at managing technical migrations or structural shifts without losing focus on the mission.

  • Compliance Domain experience: You have a deep background in scaling compliance or fintech systems. You understand the unique constraints of high-security environments and how to navigate them without slowing down.

  • Strategic Risk Manager: You are comfortable at the intersection of tech and regulation. You know how to make high-impact decisions that protect the business while enabling product growth

  • Impactful Communicator: Fluent in English (French is a bonus), you can distill complex technical or AI concepts into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders at any level.

  • Technical watch: You keep an eye on emerging tech, especially around AI. You don’t need to be an expert, but you’re eager to explore how it can help your team deliver more value, faster.


    • How to join the mission? 🚀

  • First call with Alex, our Talent Acquisition Business Partner, to better understand your background, aspirations, and answer any questions you may have. (45 minutes)

  • Interview with your future manager, Jean (VP engineering), to delve into your experience and the specifics of the role. (60 minutes)

title: Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Building a fusion company across two continents takes focus, strong relationships and thoughtful coordination. Our CEO works closely with investors, governments, strategic partners and the leadership team. You create the structure that helps him use his time effectively and arrive prepared.

This is the most senior executive support role at Focused Energy. You will work directly with the CEO as part of a closely coordinated CEO Office, in partnership with and reporting to the Chief of Staff. You will take ownership of the operational infrastructure supporting the CEO, including diary and calendar management, travel coordination, executive administration and stakeholder logistics. The Chief of Staff leads strategic priorities, substantive briefings, executive alignment and follow-through on key decisions. You ensure the practical arrangements and information flow support those priorities effectively.

When a delegation trip with twelve meetings across three countries changes at short notice, you bring the overview and experience to rebuild the plan, coordinate the people involved and keep everyone informed. You enjoy solving complex logistics and creating clarity when plans change.

You will exercise sound judgment and make day-to-day decisions independently within agreed parameters, knowing when to escalate strategic conflicts or sensitive matters. You will help establish reliable, efficient ways of working as the CEO Office develops.

You represent the CEO Office to investors, ministries, partner companies and board members. As the most experienced EA in the company, you also help shape how executive support works across Focused Energy.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and coordinate the CEO’s domestic and international travel, including complex delegations, conferences and investor or government engagements.

  • Own itineraries, participants, visas, invitations, registrations, protocol requirements, ground logistics, contingency arrangements and live coordination during trips.

  • Be willing to accompany the CEO internationally when needed, independently or alongside the Chief of Staff, while providing effective remote support on trips you do not attend.

  • Maintain a clear overview of upcoming commitments and what each requires. Anticipate conflicts, preparation needs and logistical dependencies, and act early.

  • Coordinate the timely preparation, collation and distribution of briefing materials, working with the Chief of Staff and relevant content owners.

  • Maintain clear administrative follow-up and ensure decisions, commitments and emerging priorities are promptly communicated to the Chief of Staff for strategic follow-through.

  • Build trusted relationships with investors, ministries, agencies, partner companies, board members and their offices.

  • Keep the CEO Office running effectively, including expenses, approvals, signatures, tools, records and contact management.

  • Help develop shared standards for calendar management, travel, tools and confidentiality, supporting collaboration and teamwork across the EA team, both locally and internationally.

Who You Are

  • You bring ten or more years of experience in executive support, including several years supporting a CEO, founder or managing director in an international business with extensive travel and calendar management. Experience in a growing company or investor environment is a plus.

  • You have supported highly driven, fast-moving executives and can bring structure to changing or incomplete requests.

  • You have managed complex delegation trips involving multiple participants, countries and official meetings.

  • You combine strong organisation, judgment and emotional intelligence with a calm, adaptable style and are comfortable partnering with a Chief of Staff while maintaining a direct, trusted relationship with the CEO.

  • You understand competing priorities and can make confident decisions within your remit.

  • You protect an executive’s time with diplomacy and build constructive relationships with the people seeking it.

  • You are comfortable working with board members, investors, ministries and senior executives, as well as the teams supporting them.

  • You work proactively, identifying scheduling conflicts, travel requirements and preparation needs before they become urgent.

  • You stay composed when plans change, communicate clearly and know when to bring others into a decision.

  • You handle sensitive board, investor, M&A and personnel matters with discretion.

  • You use modern scheduling and collaboration tools confidently and are interested in using AI thoughtfully to reduce repetitive work.

  • You are fluent in English and German.

  • You are based in Berlin, or willing to relocate, and comfortable travelling with the CEO when needed.

A Word On Pace

This is a demanding role, with a strong emphasis on complex calendar management, exceptional attention to detail and the delivery of high-level, hands-on executive support to the CEO of a rapidly growing international company. Priorities can shift quickly and some trips or commitments require flexibility at short notice. It calls for someone who enjoys responsibility, stays calm under pressure and communicates clearly about priorities and capacity.

In return, you can expect meaningful ownership, a close working partnership with the CEO and Chief of Staff, and the opportunity to help shape how the CEO Office operates. You will be trusted to exercise judgment within agreed responsibilities and escalation parameters.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

title: Senior Finance Manager (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

Your mission is to be an integral part of building and scaling the Finance function within lemon.markets. As Senior Finance Manager you develop processes and policies as well as support the Product Development team and other functions - becoming the go-to person for external stakeholders and auditors. You will play an important role in establishing lemon.markets as the go-to-provider for launching investment products in Europe.

At lemon.markets we value ownership a lot. Meaning you have a lot of autonomy in shaping your area of responsibility. Your report directly to our VP of Finance and collaborating closely with Risk Management, Product, Compliance, among others, making sure our Finance function is set up for long-term operational excellence and scalability. This is your opportunity to have an impact, not just on the Finance department, but also on the product, to help launch a compliant investment product.

You will:

  • Manage and optimize various Finance processes, especially within Accounting, but also Regulatory Reporting or Planning and Controlling, by leveraging your knowledge and expertise.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Finance on special and strategic projects, helping transition processes into scalable, best-in-class workflows.

  • Be a point of contact for our external auditors, ensuring timely delivery of high quality documentation by various teams.

  • Work together closely with the Management Team and build, monitor and refine our annual financial plan and timelines.

  • Support on product work, defining and documenting functional requirements, establishing test concepts and testing/documentation and associated implications.

  • Cultivate a culture of knowledge-sharing as you work closely with our Product Development team, bridging the gap between finance and innovation for strategic product advancements.

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have a strong background in Finance and regulated financial services. You have at least five years of experience in a finance function at a bank, FinTech, or another regulated institution, or with a Big Four or other leading audit firm. title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.


We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.


We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to build the product surfaces that housing providers, contractors, and residents use every day. This is a fully remote position; we currently have remote engineers based in the UK, Germany, Turkey, Poland, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. You will report to a Team Lead, a hands-on engineer who still writes code and has a small number of engineers reporting to them, and work alongside product managers, designers, backend engineers, and data analysts.


Our frontend is built on TypeScript, React, React Router, TanStack Query, MaterialUI and BaseUI, against an increasingly service-oriented backend built in Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL. The codebase is large but clean, because we put real weight on design patterns, readability, testability, maintainability, and extendability.


The engineering team sits at the centre of what Plentific does, and the problems are genuinely difficult: online payments, quoting, invoicing, booking, search and scoring algorithms, in-app messaging, real-time notifications, and fraud prevention. Much of it is high-volume and messy legacy integrations, complex permissions, strict compliance requirements, and users who need software to fit how work actually happens on the ground. We expect you to apply engineering judgement to these problems rather than only writing the code in front of you, and to treat agentic, spec-driven development as a normal part of how you work rather than an experiment.


Success in this role means shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and well-tested, raising the standard of the frontend codebase around you, and leaving the engineers you work with better than you found them.

Key Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering

  • Build and maintain product interfaces in TypeScript, React, TanStack Query, React Router, MaterialUI and BaseUI across our web applications.

  • Translate product requirements and design concepts into technical documents that set out scope, system behaviour, edge cases, and high-level technical analysis.

  • Design component APIs, state management, and data-fetching patterns that stay readable and extendable as the codebase grows.

  • Integrate against REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, shaping the contracts with backend engineers rather than accepting whatever is offered.

  • Review, refactor, and retire existing code so it meets the requirements of improved or new features.

  • Review and improve our development workflows, continuous integration checks, deployment pipelines and infrastructure.

  • Keep up to date with technology and bring in new standards and practices for improved user or developer experience

Performance, Quality, and Reliability

  • Diagnose and resolve page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests that give the team confidence to ship frequently.

  • Instrument frontend observability with tools such as Sentry, Grafana Logs or New Relic, and act on what they show.

  • Debug and fix production issues across our applications, including the integration points where frontend and backend behaviour diverge.

  • Design against common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF.

Agentic and Spec-Driven Development

  • Turn ambiguous product ideas into implementation-ready specs, including user flows, component behaviour, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and test expectations.

  • Prototype interfaces and interaction quickly, using working software to test feasibility and product value before committing to larger delivery.

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent to generate, refactor, test, and review code within clear technical constraints.

  • Evaluate AI-generated code critically for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, accessibility, and fit with Plentific's architecture.

  • Improve the team's spec-driven development practice through reusable prompt patterns, review checklists, examples, and lightweight documentation.

Collaboration and Craft

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers from problem framing through release, applying engineering judgement to improve the user experience before implementation starts.

  • Collaborate with other engineers through code review and pair programming.

  • Define and communicate frontend standards and best practices, and hold the team to them in review.

  • Write concise technical documentation covering components, algorithms, APIs, and operational handover.

  • Articulate technical trade-offs in plain English to technical and non-technical colleagues, including when scope, quality, or delivery timing needs to change.

Requirements

  • Expert-level TypeScript and modern JavaScript, with deep command of React and the patterns around it, including data fetching, routing, and component libraries.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design patterns, testing, debugging, and code that stays readable and extendable at scale.

  • Sound grasp of UI, UX and accessibility considerations, with the judgement to improve a design before building it rather than implement it exactly as drawn.

  • Demonstrable experience diagnosing and fixing page load, rendering, and other frontend performance problems.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, or New Relic, and of CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.

  • Working knowledge of frontend observability with Sentry, Grafana logs, New Relic or other tools used to monitor, diagnose and fix issues

  • Hands-on background with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions or ArgoCD) as well as modern frontend architecture patterns.

  • Practical awareness of common frontend security risks, including XSS and CSRF, and how to design against them.

  • Strong working fluency with agentic coding tools and spec-driven development workflows, including specification writing, code generation, test generation, and critical review.

  • Clear communication, with the ability to articulate technical concepts and trade-offs in plain English.

  • High ambition and a strong sense of urgency, with the drive to deliver an ambitious product roadmap at pace using AI, and a positive, can-do attitude.Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 5+ years of commercial React and TypeScript.

  • Experience shipping and operating production frontends for customer-facing SaaS products, including monitoring, incident response, and performance improvement.

  • Experience working in a large, long-lived codebase where design patterns, testability, and maintainability genuinely matter.

  • Experience consuming and shaping REST APIs in a service-oriented architecture, ideally backed by Django REST Framework or an equivalent.

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams with product managers and designers on shared customer outcomes, not only technical delivery.

  • Experience using AI coding tools in a professional software delivery workflow, ideally within a spec-driven development framework.

Benefits

We offer:

  • A salary package aligned to the role and market

  • 25 days annual holiday, plus one additional day for every year served, up to a maximum of 5 additional days

  • Fully remote working, including the option to work abroad

  • Private healthcare for you and your immediate family, with discounted gym membership and access to optical, dental, and private GP services

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance at 4× salary

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary-sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation when someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to Work, electric vehicle, and Techscheme programmes

  • Pension scheme

  • Company-sponsored dinners and social gatherings

title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

  • Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groeit en van richting verandert. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is.

  • Je hebt minmaal 5 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bij voorkeur in een tech- of IT-omgeving, en weet hoe je in die context het verschil maakt.

  • Je begrijpt de dynamiek van snelgroeiende teams en bent gewend om managers te adviseren over leiderschap, teamdynamiek en prestatieontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring met performance management en weet hoe je dat praktisch inricht voor mensen die nooit eerder in een gestructureerde cyclus hebben gewerkt.

  • Je hebt meegebouwd aan een salarishuis of vergelijkbare HR-structuur en snapt hoe je dat bespreekbaar maakt in een organisatie.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je komt binnen in een organisatie die hard groeit en volop in beweging is. Het tech, content en IT-team dat jij begeleidt staat middenin die beweging: veertig mensen, tien open stoelen en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR-partner die hen daarin niet volgt, maar voorgaat.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag één invloed hebt op de mensen, de cultuur en de groei van een van de snelst groeiende teams van Lefebvre Sdu.

  • De kans om samen te werken met een nieuw leadership team dat hun baan in big tech bewust inruilde voor de kans om hier iets te bouwen wat er nog niet was.

MEER WETEN?

title: Senior Influencer Marketing Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Ben jij de influencer-goeroe die wij zoeken?

Volg jij de nieuwste features op Instagram, TikTok, YouTube en Snapchat op de voet? Weet jij precies welke influencers op dit moment hot zijn? Beheers je zowel het Nederlands als het Engels vloeiend? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Over WPP Media

WPP Media is een dochteronderneming van WPP, het wereldwijde advertisingconglomeraat. We ondersteunen toonaangevende mediabureaus zoals Wavemaker, Mindshare en EssenceMediacom. Binnen WPP Media zijn verschillende centrale activiteiten ondergebracht, waaronder StudioM, Digital Data Hub, Business Intelligence, Proces Management, Marketing Services & Insights, Trading en Quality Management.

WPP Media is een dynamische, jonge en ambitieuze organisatie met duizenden (young) professionals wereldwijd. In Nederland hebben we kantoren in Amsterdam, Eindhoven en Sittard. Daar werken honderden collega’s voor toonaangevende klanten zoals Action, Lamb Weston, NS, Subway, M&M’s, Brabantia, IKEA en Dr. Oetker.

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam biedt een adembenemend uitzicht van 180 graden over de stad en de Amstel. De sfeer is informeel en gezellig, met regelmatig vrijdagmiddagborrels in onze skybar op de negende verdieping.

Over StudioM en de functie

Je gaat aan de slag bij StudioM, ons interne bureau voor influencer marketing. We voeren campagnes uit op grote, vaak internationale schaal. Je werkt met een breed scala aan klanten, influencers en campagnes, waardoor geen dag hetzelfde is.

In deze rol draag je zelfstandig de operationele verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe en omvangrijke projecten. Denk aan multi-marketprojecten, strategische accounts, campagnes voor meerdere merken en innovatieve trajecten.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Projectmanagement: Je bent zelfstandig verantwoordelijk voor het opzetten, uitvoeren en coördineren van influencer marketingcampagnes.
  • Planning en voortgang: Je stuurt de dagelijkse uitvoering aan, maakt duidelijke projectplanningen en bewaakt deadlines, afhankelijkheden, prioriteiten en de voortgang van projecten.
  • Influencerselectie en briefings: Je vertaalt de kaders en briefings van de accountmanager naar concrete selectielijsten, taken en creatieve briefings, waaronder influencerbriefings. Waar nodig verdeel je taken onder junior collega’s of stagiairs.
  • Relatiebeheer en onderhandelingen: Je onderhoudt relaties met influencers en talentbureaus en onderhandelt zelfstandig over marktconforme vergoedingen binnen het vastgestelde budget.
  • Budgetbeheer en administratie: Je beheert projectbudgetten en houdt kosten bij, zoals influencer fees, buy-outs en event- en productiekosten. Ook verzorg je contracten en regel je boekingen met bureaus.
  • Content en kwaliteit: Je bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van alle content en deliverables, voert eerste contentchecks uit en werkt nauw samen met accountmanagers richting definitieve goedkeuring.
  • Afstemming en rapportage: Je werkt samen met interne teams om effectieve campagnes te realiseren. Je houdt klanten, stakeholders en de accountmanager proactief op de hoogte van de dagelijkse voortgang, sluit waar nodig aan bij klantupdates en rapporteert over resultaten en aandachtspunten.
  • Risicobeheersing en optimalisatie: Je signaleert risico’s, knelpunten en optimalisatiemogelijkheden, bespreekt deze met de (senior) accountmanager en escaleert tijdig waar nodig. Je stuurt actief bij, optimaliseert lopende campagnes en voert verbeteringen door met medior- en juniorcollega’s.
  • Evaluatie en begeleiding: Je levert inhoudelijke input voor projectevaluaties, vertaalt learnings naar verbeteringen voor toekomstige campagnes en begeleidt en werkt stagiairs in binnen het team.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt een passie voor influencer marketing en leeft social media. Je kijkt liever YouTube en TikTok dan televisie en denkt in Instagram Stories.
  • Je volgt de nieuwste features en ontwikkelingen op socialmediaplatformen en weet welke influencers op dit moment relevant zijn.

Wat bieden wij?

Een boeiende baan in een vooruitstrevend en informeel team binnen een van de grootste communicatiegroepen ter wereld. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen in een inspirerende werkomgeving. En natuurlijk werk je met fijne collega’s in ons geweldige kantoor, die iedere werkdag bijzonder maken.

title: Senior Influencer Planning Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

The Senior Influencer Planning Manager is a hands-on strategic planner responsible for translating PlayStation's global influencer approach into clear, actionable plans across priority games, hardware, services, sponsorships, brand campaigns, and cultural moments. 

This role will support portfolio prioritisation, audience and creator plans, global/local processes, measurement, and investment recommendations that enable the broader Influencer Partnerships team to execute with greater clarity, consistency, and impact. 

Working closely with Influencer Partnerships, Brand, Media, Studios, Social, PR/Communications, Insights & Analytics, agencies, and local market teams, this role connects the planning approach to execution through strong briefs, planning tools, recommendations, and cross-functional coordination.

What you'll be doing:

Influencer Planning 

  • Develop planning documents, campaign frameworks, and recommendations for priority initiatives, translating audience objectives, business priorities, and cultural opportunities into actionable influencer plans. 
  • Maintain planning calendars, portfolio roadmaps, intake inputs, and decision materials across influencer workstreams. 
  • Partner with internal insights teams, agency partners, local teams, and activation leads to synthesise research into clear planning implications. 

Portfolio Prioritisation & Investment Strategy 

  • Support assessment of the appropriate influencer support model by initiative, including full-service, lighter-touch, locally led, agency-supported, or playbook-enabled approaches. 
  • Build planning inputs for investment and resource recommendations, balancing business impact, cultural opportunity, audience reach, market needs, and historical learnings. 

Global / Local Planning Model 

  • Coordinate early local market inputs, creator recommendations, market nuances, and feedback loops, translating them into clear global planning outputs. 
  • Maintain shared ways of working, planning templates, and governance that drive global consistency while supporting local relevance. 

Measurement, Learning & Cross-Functional Partnership 

  • Maintain KPI, reporting, and learning frameworks and translate campaign performance into actionable recommendations for future planning. 
  • Build and maintain planning tools, playbooks, and knowledge resources that improve speed, clarity, and consistency. 
  • Create concise stakeholder updates and leadership readouts, partnering cross-functionally to resolve planning needs and improve execution readiness.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator strategy, brand planning, social strategy, entertainment marketing, digital marketing, or integrated campaign planning. 
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business, or a related field; equivalent experience considered. 
  • Strong understanding of the creator landscape, social platforms, gaming communities, entertainment culture, youth audiences, and emerging platform behaviours. 
  • Experience translating audience insights, cultural signals, creator trends, and business priorities into clear campaign strategies and planning recommendations. 
  • Experience supporting portfolio prioritisation, investment planning, measurement, and global/local ways of working in a complex or matrixed organisation. 
  • Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and synthesise complex information into clear presentations and recommendations. 
  • Comfort working with KPIs and campaign performance data and translating results into practical planning implications. 
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across activation teams, local markets, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • AI fluency or willingness to rapidly adopt AI-enabled tools for research, trend scanning, reporting, knowledge management, and planning efficiency. 
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and high-visibility initiatives. 
  • Genuine passion for PlayStation, gaming, creators, entertainment, sports, youth culture, and the broader cultural landscape.

Benefits:

  • Discretionary bonus opportunity
  • Hybrid working model (FlexModes)
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental Scheme
  • 25 days holiday per year
  • On Site Gym
  • Subsidised Café
  • Free soft drinks
  • On site bar
  • Access to cycle garage and showers

title: Senior Integrated Marketing Strategy & Planning Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the role

  • Integrated Marketing France connects global marketing strategy with local business priorities to deliver impactful marketing campaigns.
  • As Senior Marketing Manager, Integrated Marketing, you will identify France’s priority marketing moments and translate global direction into a clear, integrated marketing plan. Using business performance, consumer insights and knowledge of the French market, you will recommend what to prioritise, what to adopt from global campaigns and what to adapt to maximise local impact.
  • You will bring teams together around clear priorities, challenge recommendations constructively, simplify complex topics and ensure marketing initiatives deliver against France’s business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy & Planning

    • Analyse business performance, consumer insights and market trends to recommend France’s priority marketing moments.
    • Translate global marketing direction into an integrated France marketing plan, identifying what to adopt, adapt or challenge based on local business needs and market specificities.
    • Develop clear, evidence-based recommendations on priorities and trade-offs, balancing expected impact, investment and available resources.
    • Build a strong rationale for local adaptations and influence global stakeholders when the French market requires a different approach.

2. Campaign Orchestration & Stakeholder Management

    • Lead campaign kick-offs and align local and global stakeholders around clear objectives, responsibilities and timelines.
    • Challenge functional recommendations constructively, asking the right questions to ensure proposed media plans, creative concepts and campaign choices meet France’s objectives.
    • Simplify complex, cross-functional topics, clarify dependencies and facilitate decisions to keep initiatives moving.
    • Anticipate delivery risks, resolve coordination challenges and ensure campaigns are delivered on time and to the agreed brief.

3. Marketing Plan Consolidation & Executive Communication

  • Consolidate the France marketing plan into a clear, executive-level overview of key priorities, campaign choices, local adaptations and expected business impact.
  • Write concise, insight-led strategic memos articulating the rationale behind France’s marketing recommendations, key trade-offs and decisions requiring alignment or approval.
  • Build a compelling, evidence-based narrative connecting France’s business priorities and market specificities with global marketing strategy.
  • Present and defend France’s marketing recommendations to global executives, ensuring local choices are understood and enabling informed decision-making.

Key Skills & Experience

    • 5+ years of experience in integrated marketing, marketing strategy, campaign planning or marketing programme management.
    • Strong business acumen, analytical thinking and the ability to translate data and consumer insights into actionable recommendations.
    • Strong critical thinking and sound judgement: able to challenge assumptions, ask the right questions and assess whether proposed marketing choices support business objectives, without needing to be the technical expert in every discipline.
    • Ability to balance global consistency with relevant local adaptation, using clear evidence and constructive influencing skills.
    • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and align teams without direct authority.
    • Strong organisational skills, pragmatism and ownership, with a focus on prioritisation and delivery.
    • Fluent in French and English, with the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders in an international environment.

Success Measures

    • A clear, business-led recommendation of France’s priority marketing moments.
    • Relevant local adaptations of global campaigns, supported by clear rationale and market insights.
    • Strong alignment across stakeholders on priorities, decisions and delivery.
