title: Senior Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solvethe hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You've earned your engineering judgment on complex machines. You hold a PhD or Master's in physics, engineering, or an adjacent field, and you have years of experience in industries where integration challenges are at the heart of the design, such as aerospace or Formula 1.

  • You are not afraid of different physics domains. You feel comfortable navigating the different physics regimes of a Stellarator - from waves propagating in a plasma to cryogenic properties of steel.

  • You reach for whatever tool fits. Being a pen-and-paper calculation, a simulator you coded last night, or a commercial multiphysics package, the method serves the question, never the reverse.

  • You build consensus. You are a low-ego high-clarity communicator who works effectively with multiple technical leads, to bring integration challenges and system-level tradeoffs to a clear decision.

  • You commit to a concrete outcome. Every study, tool, and memo you produce ends in an actionable insight and a clear next step, otherwise it didn't happen.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at L3 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

descriptionHtml:
PLANETHOME INVESTMENTS


Senior Investment Consultant Wohn- & Geschäftshäuser (m/w/d)

Standort: Hamburg | Fokus: Neuaufbau PlanetHome Investments

Der Hamburger Investmentmarkt schläft nicht. Und wir auch nicht.

PlanetHome zählt seit Jahren zu den führenden Immobilienvermittlern Deutschlands. Für den Aufbau von PlanetHome Investments suchen wir keine Verwalter bestehender Strukturen. Wir suchen Unternehmer im Unternehmen: Macher, die einen Geschäftsbereich von Anfang an mitgestalten wollen. Deine Vorteile – Eine starke Plattform im Rücken:

· Etablierte Marke: Vertrauen und Schlagkraft eines führenden Immobilienunternehmens.

Notartermin.

WAS DU MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST

WAS DU VON UNS ERWARTEN KANNST

title: Senior Java Engineer - Contract
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

You will form part of a cross-functional agile team, working closely with 3-5 other engineers working closely with QA, Product and Design teams to deliver high-quality work for clients across a number of industries.

We strive to create the best product possible with everyone's effort, and you'll be an integral part of that mission. Your role in the team is highly valued, and you'll be a key player in ensuring the success of our projects.

Our Tech:

Our backend team focuses on the following tech stack:

  • Java
  • RESTful Java APIs
  • Kafka
  • AWS
  • CI/CD

What you'll be doing:

  • Developing RESTful Java APIs, including interaction with databases with a focus on readable, maintainable and well-tested code
  • Integrating with third-party APIs such as payment gateways
  • Collaborating with the full project team (including BAs, QAs and members of the client team) to provide the best solutions to our clients
  • Identifying bottlenecks in the software delivery process and removing any roadblocks that arise
  • Professional handling of difficult client communications for specific issues
  • Identifying knowledge gaps and mentoring opportunities for your team
  • Being able to define and oversee the technical implementation of a client project

We'd love to talk to you if: 

  • You have strong knowledge of API development using Java, including ORM storage
  • You actively facilitate and encourage knowledge sharing within the team and wider department
  • You advocate for best engineering practices such as code reviews, paired programming, and automated tests
  • You are familiar with cloud services and CI/CD (this is a bonus)
  • You are Using Agentic AI to develop and deploy solutions.
  • You are Utilising cloud-based, AI enabled workflows to increase productivity.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior Licensing Manager
descriptionHtml:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.

At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.

As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA will play a critical role in strategically growing and leading the UEFA Masterlicense business unit.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA serves as the senior lead for the UEFA Masterlicense business, owning client and licensee relationships while ensuring operational and financial objectives are met with precision and efficiency. This role partners closely with senior leadership to develop and execute strategic licensing plans that maximize revenue, position client brands appropriately, and identify new business opportunities across the European licensing landscape. The Director, Licensing – UEFA delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT

Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Communicate division strategy clearly across licensing, legal, finance, and operations teams to ensure cohesive execution against the UEFA Masterlicense program's goals and objectives.
  • Partner with senior leadership to report key business results to corporate officers and align divisional priorities with enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Finance on royalty reporting and royalty accounting, and with Legal on contract drafting and negotiation, ensuring seamless cross-functional delivery.

People Leadership:

  • Lead and direct the UEFA licensing business unit, setting performance goals for direct reports and providing ongoing evaluation against the group's objectives.
  • Develop team members through clear expectations, coaching, and alignment to BOLD leadership principles to build a high-performing licensing organization.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

  • Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with UEFA and all licensing clients, key stakeholders, business partners, and strategic alliances to advance each client's licensing program.
  • Maintain an in-depth working knowledge of all Fanatics Licensing Management (FLM) clients to proactively anticipate needs and deliver consistently high levels of service.
  • Oversee day-to-day management of client licensing programs — including contract negotiation and royalty reporting — ensuring clients receive accurate, timely, and strategic partnership support.
  • Represent FLM at industry licensing trade shows and participate in business sessions with leading licensees to strengthen relationships and elevate the Fanatics brand in the European market.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

  • Assist in identifying new business opportunities that align with high-quality business strategies and support both short-term and long-term objectives of the UEFA licensing program.
  • Work with the senior leadership team to develop and implement innovative strategic licensing plans that position client brands competitively and maximize licensing revenue.
  • Continuously evaluate operational and logistics processes within the licensing business unit, identifying improvements that drive greater efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Stay connected to industry trends and competitive dynamics in the European sports licensing landscape, bringing forward-thinking perspectives to client and business strategy.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

  • Own the day-to-day management of the P&L for the UEFA licensing business unit, ensuring the division achieves its strategic and financial objectives.
  • Oversee the development of annual reports for clients, delivering accurate and insightful performance summaries that inform future licensing strategy.
  • Manage competing priorities and complex stakeholder relationships simultaneously, operating with exceptional attention to detail and a self-starter mindset in a fast-paced environment.
  • Take full accountability for divisional results, driving a culture of relentless execution and continuous improvement across all licensing operations.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

  • Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
  • Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
  • Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in the licensing industry, with demonstrated expertise in managing licensing programs, client relationships, and contractual obligations.
  • 5+ years of experience in customer and client relations, with a proven ability to build and sustain strategic partnerships at a senior level.
  • 3+ years of management experience, including directing teams and evaluating performance against defined business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a business unit P&L and deliver against financial and strategic targets.
  • Experience in contract negotiation and working cross-functionally with Legal and Finance teams on licensing agreements and royalty processes.
  • Motivated self-starter with the ability to excel at multi-tasking in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office; strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present key results to senior and corporate leadership.

Education:

Bachelor's degree required.

WORK LOCATION

On-site: Your work location will be onsite in Paris or Manchester.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined and Relentless Mindset. If you’re ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.

ABOUT US

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

ABOUT THE TEAM

title: Senior Manager, Design Delivery, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Design Delivery to own and lead the delivery of coordinated, multidisciplinary designs for Volta’s AI factory projects in EMEA.

You will be accountable for project design delivery throughout the design stage and remain closely engaged with the Delivery team through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover. You will manage the design scope and associated programme, interfaces and deliverables, ensuring the right information and decisions are available when needed to support successful project delivery.

Working closely with the Volta Product, Technology, Corporate Development, Engineering, Operations and Delivery teams, you will translate requirements into a clear project design brief and lead external design partners in applying Volta’s Reference Design to each site. You will move easily between technical detail and the wider project picture, balancing performance, reliability, cost, speed of delivery and operability. The role will also involve liaising with customer teams to incorporate their requirements into the project design brief.

What You Will Do

› Own the delivery of the project design from initial brief through to detailed design, ensuring design deliverables meet the agreed scope, quality, budget and programme requirements.

› Provide ongoing design support through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, assisting the Delivery team during these stages.

› Establish and maintain the project design brief with customers, Product, Engineering, Operations and Delivery, capturing requirements, scope boundaries, acceptance criteria and responsibilities.

› Develop and manage the design delivery programme, aligning design packages, reviews, approvals and information release with key project milestones.

› Coordinate design inputs to planning, permitting and statutory approvals with local design partners and the relevant Volta teams, ensuring requirements and approval conditions are incorporated into the design and delivery programme.

› Lead and coordinate external design partners across all disciplines, setting clear scopes, deliverables and accountabilities and managing performance against agreed quality, programme and budget expectations.

› Manage the application of Volta’s Reference Design and engineering standards to each project, coordinating site-specific adaptations and securing approval from the relevant technical authorities for departures.

› Lead multidisciplinary design coordination reviews, resolving interfaces between civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls and GPU compute infrastructure to ensure the overall design works as one integrated AI factory.

› Act as the principal point of coordination for project design matters, working closely with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve requirements, secure timely decisions and maintain alignment as the design develops.

› Plan and lead design reviews and stage gates, ensuring deliverables are complete, coordinated and appropriately reviewed, with comments, actions and approvals tracked to closure.

› Work with the Project Controls, Delivery and Procurement teams to define design package boundaries and release priorities, support technical tender evaluations and incorporate supplier and contractor design information into the coordinated project design.

› Embed construction sequencing, prefabrication, modular delivery, access, logistics and maintainability into the design, working with the teams that will build and operate the facility.

› Manage design changes through a clear change control process, assessing their impact on scope, cost, programme, capacity and performance and securing the required approvals before implementation.

› Remain closely engaged during construction, coordinating responses to technical queries, design clarifications, submittals and proposed changes with designers and engineering, so site teams receive timely, approved information.

› Work with Operations and commissioning teams to incorporate testing, commissioning, maintenance and handover requirements into the design, including the information needed for safe and effective operation.

› Champion best practice health and safety throughout design delivery, leading multidisciplinary reviews to eliminate foreseeable hazards and reduce H&S risks through design.

› Maintain clear visibility of design risks, assumptions, interfaces and outstanding decisions, escalating issues early and reporting design delivery status to project leadership

What You Will Bring

› A degree in engineering, architecture, construction or equivalent relevant experience.

› Significant experience managing multidisciplinary design delivery for large scale data centres, AI factories or similarly complex infrastructure.

› A track record of taking projects from concept through detailed design and supporting procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.

› Strong understanding of the interfaces between building infrastructure, power, cooling, controls and compute, including the requirements of high-density AI and GPU facilities.

› Experience translating customer, product and operational requirements into clear design briefs and coordinated project deliverables.

› Proven ability to lead external consultants and coordinate internal technical specialists, suppliers and contractors around a common delivery programme.

› Experience managing design programmes, consultant scopes and fees, stage gate reviews, design changes and technical information release.

› An understanding of how reference designs are adapted to site conditions, local requirements and project-specific needs while maintaining consistency across a portfolio.

› Strong commercial judgement, balancing design quality, capex, schedule, constructability, reliability and operability.

› Familiarity with BIM coordination, common data environments and document control processes that support effective multidisciplinary design delivery.

› Experience integrating offsite manufacturing, prefabrication and DFMA into coordinated project designs and delivery programmes.

› Confident communication, able to explain design issues, trade-offs and decisions clearly to customers, technical teams and senior stakeholders.

› A collaborative and accountable approach, with the ability to resolve competing priorities, challenge incomplete information and drive decisions through to closure.

› Willingness to travel to project sites periodically, customer meetings and design partner locations across EMEA.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

title: Senior Manager, Digital Risk & Cyber
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres - they are where value is won or lost. 

The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.

We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.

We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.

We work in small, senior teams – so you own real client relationships and real commercial outcomes from day one. We're looking for Senior Managers who want to be the name clients ask for and the market knows. This is a role for people who want to win and deliver work while they build a practice: originating opportunities, leading complex engagements, and growing the reputations – theirs and ours – that open the next door.

Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise 

Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:

  • Digital Resilience: helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.
  • Digital Trust: helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.

We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.

We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.

What you will be doing

  • Win the work: Originate, scope and close opportunities – building pipeline, shaping proposals and taking personal accountability for a share of the practice's growth.

  • Lead the work: Run complex, multi-workstream engagements as the senior expert clients trust – setting direction, owning the commercials, and being accountable for quality and impact.

  • Lead the people: Build, motivate and stretch delivery teams – coaching Consultants, Senior Consultants and Managers, and making Baringa a place strong people want to stay.

  • Own the relationships: Build and hold trusted relationships at CISO and executive level, turning single engagements into lasting accounts.

  • Be the expert others seek out: Become a recognised SME – Internally and in the market – through points of view, speaking and content that open specific client conversations.

  • Build the business: Contribute to our propositions, our go-to-market and our talent, taking a real stake in how fast we grow – as a member of the team building the practice, not just running engagements.

 
Your skills and experience  

We care more about the shape of your experience than a checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd like to hear from you:

  • A track record of winning work: Demonstrable experience originating and closing cyber, resilience or digital risk work – building pipeline, shaping bids and owning a personal sales contribution.
  • Engagement leadership: The credibility to lead complex, multi-workstream engagements as a senior expert, balancing deep cyber knowledge with commercial and stakeholder judgement.
  • People leadership: Experience leading and developing mixed delivery teams, and coaching others to perform.
  • Senior client relationships: A network you can activate, and the ability to build trusted relationships at CISO and board level.
  • Digital risk and cyber depth: A strong track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, gained in consulting or in-house, and a clear view on where the market is heading – DORA, the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill, CAF, AI and cloud risk.
  • Technology and AI literacy: Fluency in, or real curiosity about, using AI to deliver and advising clients on securing and governing it.
  • Depth in one or more of our domains: Meaningful experience in at least one area we operate in – particularly OT/ICS security, CAF, AI security and governance, post-quantum and cryptographic agility, or operational resilience. 

Bonus points 

  • Certifications: For example CISSP, CCSP or AIGP – a plus, but no substitute for real-world experience.
  • Building tooling and automation: Hands-on with building, not just using – for example agentic AI, Power BI, Power Apps, risk quantification models or digital twins.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

descriptionHtml:
SW Studios GmbH ist ein innovatives und wachsendes Unternehmen, das mit unseren hauseigenen Marken, Eightyfive und Burocs, die Modebranche prägt. Durch erstklassige Qualität und ein starkes Gespür für Trends haben wir uns in Deutschland und international einen Namen gemacht. Neben unseren erfolgreichen Online-Shops und B2B Projekten, sind wir mit drei Feature Stores in Hamburg HafenCity, Hannover und Oberhausen sowie zwei Add. Stores in München und Hamburg-Billstedt an insgesamt fünf Standorten präsent.

Arbeiten bei SW Studios GmbH bedeutet mehr als nur ein Job. Es ist deine Chance, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzugestalten, deine Ideen einzubringen und gemeinsam mit einem motivierten Team zu wachsen. Wir setzen auf flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation und kreative Freiheit – denn nur so entstehen Innovationen.

Unser modernes Headquarter in Hannover bietet dir ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Stärken zählen. Egal, ob du analytisch, kreativ oder strategisch denkst – bei uns kannst du dich weiterentwickeln und echte Verantwortung übernehmen.

Wenn du motiviert bist, über dich selbst hinauszuwachsen und das Unternehmen langfristig mit deiner Energie voranzubringen, dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und bewirb dich jetzt!

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst E-Commerce-Strategien für Eightyfive, Burocs und Feature Stores – und setzt sie selbst um
  • Du analysierst KPIs, erkennst Muster und übersetzt beides in konkrete Maßnahmen mit echtem Impact
  • Du optimierst unsere drei Shops kontinuierlich: Conversion, AOV, Retention – auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht Bauchgefühl
  • Du steuerst Performance Marketing über Meta und TikTok – Budgets, Kampagnenstruktur, Attribution
  • Du verantwortest unsere CRM- und E-Mail-Strategie (Klaviyo)
  • Du koordinierst das Zusammenspiel zwischen Online und unseren fünf Retail-Standorten – von POS-Daten bis zu kanalübergreifenden Aktionen
  • Du unterstützt das B2B Wholesale-Geschäft mit relevanten Partnern - Datenaufbereitung, Timing, Prozesse
  • Du führst ein Team, das liefert – und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem alle besser werden
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Marketing, Design und Logistik zusammen – keine langen Abstimmungsschleifen
  • Du bringst neue Tools, Automations und Workflows ein, wenn sie echten Mehrwert bringen

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Commerce, idealerweise in der Modebranche
  • Hands-on-Mentalität – du analysierst und packst selbst mit an
  • Teamführungskompetenzen und die Fähigkeit, ein motiviertes Team zu leiten
  • Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und der Anwendung von E-Commerce-Tools
  • Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

Benefits

• Flexible Arbeitszeiten
• Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsfreiheit
• Klare Briefings und professionelle Prozesse
• Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit der neuesten Technik
• Schnelle Entscheidungen und flache Hierarchien
• Austausch und Feedback im motivierten Design- & Produktteam
• Mitarbeiterrabatt
• Saisonale Firmenveranstaltungen und Teamevents

Komm zu SW Studios als Senior Manager im E-Commerce (m/w/d) und gestalte die Zukunft der Modebranche mit! Genieße flexible Arbeitszeiten, moderne Technik und coole Teamevents. Werde Teil unseres kreativen Teams!

title: Senior Manager Master Data & Governance (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die strategische Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-Management- und Governance-Strukturen und sorgen dafür, dass zentrale Unternehmensdaten zuverlässig und systemübergreifend verfügbar sind. Sie gestalten Datenmodelle, Prozesse und Schnittstellen, optimieren die Datenqualität und begleiten Integrations-, Migrations- und Transformationsprojekte. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit Fachbereichen und IT zusammen, bewerten bestehende Datenstrukturen und entwickeln nachhaltige Lösungen für eine zukunftsfähige Datenlandschaft. Sie erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld, in dem Sie Verantwortung übernehmen und die Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Datenmanagements aktiv mitgestalten.

Sie kennen jemanden, der auf die Stellenausschreibung passt? Dann holen Sie sich jetzt unseren Weiterempfehlungsbonus!

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Master-Data-Management-Strukturen und -Prozesse

  • Analyse und Konsolidierung zentraler Stammdaten aus unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen

  • Sicherstellung einer einheitlichen, vollständigen und qualitativ hochwertigen Datenbasis über alle relevanten Systeme hinweg

  • Gestaltung und Dokumentation von Datenmodellen, Zuständigkeiten, Datenflüssen und führenden Quellsystemen

  • Koordination von Integrations-, Migrations- und Transformationsvorhaben im Bereich Datenmanagement

  • Implementierung und Optimierung von Data-Governance-, Validierungs- und Datenbereinigungsprozessen in Zusammenarbeit mit IT und Fachbereichen

Ihr Profil

  • Berufserfahrung im Master Data Management, Data Management oder in einem vergleichbaren datenbezogenen Umfeld

  • Praxiserfahrung mit Master Data Management Lösungen wie Boomi, Informatica IDMC oder Reltio sind von Vorteil

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stammdatenobjekten, beispielsweise Kunden, Produkte, Werke, Autoren oder Verträge

  • Erfahrung mit ERP-, CRM-, PIM- und E-Commerce-Systemen, idealerweise SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce, Censhare oder vergleichbaren Lösungen

  • Kenntnisse in der Anbindung heterogener Systemlandschaften über APIs, Events oder dateibasierte Schnittstellen sowie im Datenqualitätsmanagement

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative, Teamorientierung, Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise im Austausch mit Fachbereichen und IT

Das Angebot

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und flexibles Arbeiten

  • 37,5 Stunden / Woche

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Empfehle erfolgreich jemanden für die Stelle, und Du erhältst eine Werbeprämie von 1000 Euro

title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game.

You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar.

You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels.

  • Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class

  • Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression

  • Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience.

  • Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes.

  • Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision.

  • Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps.

    • Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards.

  • Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving.

What You Have

  • Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games.

  • Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes.

  • Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers.

  • Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

What We're Looking for

  • A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously.

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards.

  • A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar.

  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

  • A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Hey, You Might Love It Here!

Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™

Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not Sure if You Should Apply?

Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotic Systems
descriptionHtml:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.

Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission. Every one of these solutions starts as physical hardware — robotic workcells that we design, build, and commission in our own labs before they go into production.

We are looking for a passionate Senior Mechanical Engineer for Robotic Systems to turn robotics concepts into reliable physical systems. In this role, you will design the mechanical parts of our workcells, build and assemble them in our labs, and make sure they meet the relevant safety standards. You will own our lab infrastructure, tooling, and material, and be the hands-on partner for our robotics, software, and application engineers. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Design mechanical parts, fixtures, grippers, mounts, and enclosures for the robotic workcells in our labs and in customer projects
  • Validate workcell and production line concepts in simulation — reachability, collisions, and cycle times — before any hardware is built
  • Construct, assemble, and commission complete robotic workcells — from the frame and mounting concept to cabling and final integration
  • Create and maintain CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials, and prepare parts for manufacturing via CAM and 3D printing
  • Build up a library of reusable mechanical modules, standard components, and design templates, and feed lessons learned from existing workcells back into it, so that each new cell is faster to design than the last
  • Own the organization of our labs, including tools, equipment, material stock, and the procurement of mechanical components
  • Ensure that our workcells adhere to the relevant machine safety norms and support risk assessments, safeguarding concepts, and technical documentation
  • Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to translate application requirements into robust mechanical solutions
  • Travel to customer and deployment sites to support the installation, commissioning, and on-site adaptation of workcells (up to 20% of working time)

Essential Skills

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience, e.g. a technical apprenticeship with several years of relevant work
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in mechanical design, machine building, or industrial automation
  • Solid CAD skills (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, Creo) for part and assembly design including technical drawings
  • Experience with robot simulation and offline programming environments (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Visual Components)
  • Practical experience with CAM and common manufacturing processes (milling, turning, sheet metal) as well as with 3D printing, including design for manufacturability
  • Experience with aluminum profile systems, linear axes, fixtures, and standard mechanical components
  • Experience with robotic hardware (robot arms, grippers, cameras, AGVs, sensors, etc.)
  • Hands-on mindset — you enjoy building, assembling, and commissioning hardware yourself
  • Knowledge of machine safety norms and a structured approach to safe workcell design
  • Structured and independent working style with a strong sense of order in the lab
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Knowledge of electrical engineering: wiring, control cabinets, and the integration of sensors and actuators
  • Experience with pneumatics: valves, cylinders, vacuum grippers, and air supply
  • Familiarity with functional safety standards and safety equipment (e.g., EN ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, EN ISO 13849, safety scanners, light curtains, emergency stop circuits)
  • Experience working with external manufacturing suppliers and in procurement
  • Basic programming skills (e.g., Python) or experience with PLC programming
  • German language skills

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

  • Investigate material-related issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong expertise in metallic materials, surface treatments, joining technologies, and assembly methods.

  • Sound knowledge of aerospace certification and regulatory requirements.

  • Familiarity with EASA, FAA, and FOCA regulations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Fluent German and English language skills are essential.

What You'll Bring

  • A passion for aerospace technology and innovation.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach to materials qualification and compliance.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • The ability to translate complex technical requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Why Apply?

Join a highly innovative aerospace environment where your expertise will directly contribute to the development of safe, certified, and high-performance aircraft. title: Senior National Account Manager - Industry & Manufacturing
locations: Tunbridge Wells District, England, United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
The Practical Detail
Location: Southwark, London
Working Model: Hybrid

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will lead the commercial growth of Flora Professional's Industry & Manufacturing business across the UK and Ireland, driving sustainable revenue growth and securing new strategic partnerships. This role is vital to expanding Flora's presence in key sectors such as bakery, desserts, soups, sauces, and beverages. By combining commercial expertise with culinary innovation, you will help manufacturers create exceptional food products that meet evolving consumer needs. Your work will directly support Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food solutions that inspire kitchens and delight consumers.

What you'll do

  • Lead the execution of Flora Professional's growth strategy across Industry & Manufacturing sectors, identifying new commercial opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with procurement, commercial, technical, and culinary stakeholders at leading food manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with Culinary, Marketing, Technical, and R&D teams to develop innovative recipes and product applications that showcase Flora's portfolio.
  • Drive commercial excellence through negotiations, joint business planning, pricing discussions, and long-term agreements.
  • Manage and coach a Junior Key Account Manager, fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.

Performance
You will own the commercial growth of a key business area generating over 45% gross margin in the UK channel. Your data-driven approach and commercial insight will ensure sustainable revenue growth, improved customer engagement, and operational excellence. Success will be measured by your ability to meet growth targets, secure new partnerships, and maintain strong sales performance.

Care
This role reports to senior leadership and includes line management of a Junior Key Account Manager. You will work closely across functions including Marketing, Technical, R&D, Culinary, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure aligned and sustainable commercial execution. Your decisions will balance short-term results with long-term partnerships and responsible business practices that build lasting value for Flora and its customers.

Passion
You are a food lover and innovator who thrives on combining commercial success with culinary creativity. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, functionality, and reliability drives you to help customers develop exceptional products that stand out in the market. You take pride in contributing to Flora Food Group's future-focused approach to better food, inspiring kitchens and consumers alike.

About you
You bring proven experience managing strategic B2B accounts within Foodservice, FMCG, or Industry & Manufacturing, with a strong track record of growing long-term commercial opportunities. You understand the complexity of manufacturing customers and excel at building trusted partnerships. Your commercial acumen is demonstrated through leading negotiations, pricing, and joint business planning. You communicate effectively, influence stakeholders, and work cross-functionally with diverse teams. Your entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and curiosity help you identify new opportunities and challenge the status quo.

You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to senior commercial leadership positions within Flora Professional or broader commercial roles across the business. Over time, you can expect to take on greater responsibility for shaping strategy and leading larger teams, influencing Flora Food Group's growth across multiple markets.

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance.

  • Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process.

  • Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements.

  • Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets.

  • Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective.

  • Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose.

  • Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents.

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes.

  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services.

  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A German-qualified lawyer (Volljurist:in), having successfully completed both State Examinations.

  • 4–10 years of experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, and significant experience advising B2B technology businesses, either in-house or in private practice.

  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, with proven experience applying these regulations in B2B software, SaaS, AI or technology infrastructure environments.

  • Hands-on experience advising companies that develop or provide enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, APIs or other data-intensive B2B technology solutions.

  • A good understanding of AI technologies, particularly AI models, infrastructure and enterprise applications, and the privacy and regulatory challenges associated with their development, deployment and commercialisation.

  • Experience negotiating and advising on B2B commercial agreements, including data processing agreements (DPAs), international data transfers, enterprise customer contracts and complex controller/processor arrangements.

  • Comfortable working closely with product, engineering and infrastructure teams, understanding technical architectures, data flows and product development processes to provide practical, commercially focused legal advice.

  • A commercial approach to risk management, with an understanding of the challenges facing high-growth B2B technology companies and the ability to find workable solutions that support product development and commercial objectives.

  • Experience working within an international B2B technology business, particularly one scaling its enterprise customer base or operating across multiple jurisdictions, would be beneficial.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

title: Senior Product Manager - Bookkeeping
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Product Principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In almost 7 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €225 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1300+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1M+ small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 4,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

Autopilot is Pennylane’s AI add-on for accounting firms, designed to automate bookkeeping and move accountants from execution to supervision—with a clear ambition: a 1-click VAT return.

The challenge is no longer only to build a powerful product, but to activate it at scale, prove its value and turn adoption into revenue.

As the first PM of the new Bookkeeping / Autopilot Growth squad, you will play a central role in making that happen. You will help hundreds of thousands of companies adopt Autopilot, connect firms to the value it already delivers and shape Pennylane’s AI monetization strategy.

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Product Manager

As a Senior Product Manager, you will join a 100+ person Product organization, working with 300+ engineers to make Autopilot the default way firms run their bookkeeping.

You will:

  • Understand what drives adoption. Talk to firm owners and accountants, analyse product data with SQL, Amplitude and Metabase, and identify where firms hesitate to activate Autopilot.

  • Turn insights into measurable growth. Define clear hypotheses, metrics and stop criteria, then run B2B experiments through holdouts, cohort analysis and staged rollouts.

  • Own the growth strategy. Set your OKRs, shape the roadmap and focus the squad on the initiatives that drive activation, trust, usage and revenue.

  • Build with a cross-functional squad. Partner closely with a Product Designer, Engineering Manager and product-focused engineers, starting with MVPs and iterating based on what you learn.

  • Work across the ecosystem. Collaborate with the squads building Bookkeeping and Autopilot, as well as Data, Product Marketing, Pricing, Sales, Customer Success and Account Management.

  • Scale adoption beyond the product. Design in-product and lifecycle experiences that help firms self-serve, while providing commercial teams with the signals they need to support adoption.

  • Build for France and Germany from day one. Design configurable solutions rather than simple translations, and work with the German team to make what works in France scalable internationally.

  • Help define a new way of building product. Work agentic-first, design for supervision and stay relentlessly user-obsessed—using AI tools and agents every day to explore data, prototype and move faster.

WHAT you can expect from your life at Pennylane

Within one month

  • You'll learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week

  • You'll familiarize yourself with the product, the accounting industry and the accountant channel (you will have access to a lot of documentation and will attend trainings organized by your peers)

  • You'll understand how Autopilot works: what it automates, how confident it is, and where it still needs a human

  • You'll have mapped the Autopilot adoption funnel, at company and firm level: eligible, enabled, expanded, paying

Within 3 months

  • You'll have set the adoption baseline and targets with your manager

  • You'll have shipped and read your first experiments on activation, hand in hand with your Product Designer and Engineers

  • You'll have impacted positively at least one OKR

  • You will have set up your continuous discovery routine with firms and be ready to build your roadmap

Within 6 months

  • You'll be autonomous at defining your OKRs and your roadmap

  • You'll have shipped at least one step change in how firms activate Autopilot

  • You'll have made the time Autopilot saves visible to firm owners

  • You'll have prepared the switch to paid with Pricing, Product Marketing and Sales

  • You'll have equipped Account Managers and CSMs with an adoption playbook they actually use

  • You'll share your learnings and playbooks with the other Autopilot squads and with Germany

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to;

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us;

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it;

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness;

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French;

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment;

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to the French Alps and it was fabulous !).

 

And.. If you're based in 🇫🇷 :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get 10 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

What does the recruitment process look like?

  • You will first have a general chat with Charlène, Talent Acquisition Manager (45 min)

  • You'll then have a discussion with one member of our Product team to assess the fit and the Product culture (45 min)

  • You'll then pass a live case study on an Autopilot adoption problem with 2 Product Managers from our team (1h15)

  • You'll have a final round with Tancrède (our CPO) and a Group PM or a Head of Product (60 min)

We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

Language

For this specific role, a full fluent level in French 🇫🇷 is required.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience driving growth, adoption or monetization, ideally in B2B SaaS or a scaled B2C product, with measurable results;

  • Strong data fluency and hands-on analytical skills: you can go from SQL query to dashboard to actionable decision, using Amplitude or equivalent tools—even when the data is imperfect;

  • Rigour in experimentation: you know when sample sizes are too small for A/B testing and can design robust holdouts, cohorts and staged rollouts instead;

  • A strong understanding of AI-powered products: you can assess automation quality across confidence, accuracy, coverage and evaluation—and know what it takes to build user trust;

  • Excellent product sense and user research skills: you can uncover what makes professional users comfortable delegating critical work to a machine;

  • Strong cross-functional leadership: you influence and align multiple squads and commercial teams without relying on formal authority;

  • Clear, structured communication skills, with fluency in French and professional proficiency in English;

  • Previous Product Management experience in a scale-up or large technology company.

Experience in accounting is not required, but curiosity for the domain and comfort with complexity are essential. Experience with pricing and packaging, free-to-paid transitions, paid add-ons, lifecycle/CRM or sales-assisted PLG would be a strong plus.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. title: Senior Product Manager, Data & Platform (SaaS / Remote)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission:

Publitas turns retailers' static catalogs into interactive, shoppable digital experiences for brands across Europe and North America. We're a small, fully remote product organisation.

You'll be hands-on: in the codebase, in the data, prototyping with AI and shipping yourself. The default assumption is that you can figure it out, not that someone else will figure it out for you.

What you'll own

A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome.

Your first 90 days

  • Day 30 - You know your key stakeholders, have a baseline understanding of the product area and its challenges, and a working relationship with the team. You understand how the product is built and where the data lives well enough to form your own view, not one handed to you. A first version of the roadmap is on the table.

  • Day 60 - You've made your first major call - a scope cut, a kill, a bet - grounded in evidence and explicit about what would change your mind. You've found the gap between what was decided in your area and what actually ships, and closed at least one. You've put something real in front of customers or the team that you built yourself - a prototype, a working change - rather than waited for.

  • Day 90 - Your roadmap is trustworthy: Now, Next and Later are current and nobody has to ask what's happening. You've shipped your first prototype yourself, and your team is working AI-first.


What we need from you

  • Builder depth. You understand how software is built well enough to prototype against live services with AI tools, pull your own data, and ship without waiting for an engineer.

  • Evidence over summaries. You've made expensive go/no-go calls - a migration, a vendor choice, killing a product - from the evidence underneath, and you can explain what you decided, why, and what would have changed your mind.

  • Senior product experience. You've scaled a B2B product and know what that takes: the retention politics, the roadmap pressure from customer-facing teams, the trade-offs nobody wants to make.

  • Lived AI experience. You've shipped real work where AI did part of it and you can tell us exactly where it went wrong. You think in workflows and systems, not prompts.

  • Proactivity in an async team. You set priorities, make trade-offs, and decide what ships.

  • Excellent written English. We're fully remote and async-first; most of your influence travels in writing.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Compensation: Your salary is geo-bracketed to your location, with flexibility within the bracket based on your experience and what you bring to the role. A clear, performance-based path for progression follows from there.

  • Real Ownership: Full autonomy over priorities, sequencing, and what ships within your pillars, plus the mandate to define how an entire product organization works with AI.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are "AI-curious"; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.
