title: Senior Product Manager - Investing (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. We enable everyone to be an investor.

lemon.markets builds infrastructure for financial services and technology companies powering the next generation of investment products. From enabling a FinTech to launch their first investment product, over allowing e.g. a Neobank to embed investing into their product to bringing investing into a completely new context. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months.

We have experienced first hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that we make investing more accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional (& diverse) people like you.

Your Mission:

As Senior Product Manager, Investing, you own this domain end to end. You set its strategy and roadmap, run discovery and delivery, and answer for its outcomes. You represent the domain to some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe and to our dwpbank counterparts, and you are the go-to person internally, collaborating where it moves us forward and holding the line where it matters.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you lead the domain's product work. The remit is large, strategically and in delivery, and it grows as the domain grows. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

You will:

  • Own the Investing product domain and its outcomes, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration

  • Run product discovery and delivery inside a cross-functional crew with operations and engineering

  • Shape and drive the strategy and roadmap for the entire domain: order flow, execution, trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the instrument universe

  • Act as the domain go-to person and go-to expert for everything that happens before and after an order

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects: scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise

  • Partner with risk, finance, and compliance so that what we build is compliant by design

  • Work across other product teams and solutions engineering to keep partner-specific integrations sustainable on our platform

You will be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least four years of product experience and have independently shipped complex products from problem definition through launch and iteration.

  • You have strong product craft, combining customer insight, business thinking and technical understanding to make sound product decisions.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable experimenting with them, challenging their limitations and finding practical ways to improve your output.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity, bringing structure to unclear problem spaces and making confident decisions before every answer is available.

  • You use data and evidence to guide your decisions, while remaining open to changing your position when new information emerges.

  • You build trust across Engineering, Compliance and enterprise partnerships, communicate clearly in writing and bring the energy to challenge assumptions and move people forward.

  • You thrive on ownership. You are intrinsically motivated to create impact by delivering high quality outcomes for our customers by taking initiative and challenging the status quo.

  • You have a collaborative mindset. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes natural to you. While you will have a lot of autonomy delivering your projects, you understand the necessity of cross-functional work, a certain pragmatism & dedication to our mission.

  • You are a great communicator in English and German.. Working in a start-up can be messy & unstructured at times, you’re able to sift through the noise, and assess what's really critical. You create buy-in for your plans from your stakeholders by applying a strong writing culture.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our growing Product Marketing team and help shape how Addepar goes to market across EMEA, LATAM and APAC. You will become a trusted expert on the buyers, segments, market dynamics, competitive landscapes and regional nuances that influence how we position Addepar and engage prospects and clients in each market.

You’ll work closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams, along with Product and other go-to-market partners, to translate market insight into differentiated positioning, campaigns, enablement and launch strategies. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for a product marketer who can connect Addepar’s global platform narrative to the distinct needs, use cases and product availability of each region.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and execute product marketing strategies for clients and prospects across EMEA, LATAM and APAC, aligned with company and platform priorities.
  • Build deep market expertise by understanding regional buyers, buying committees, client needs, competitive dynamics and cultural nuances.
  • Partner closely with regional Sales, Relationship Management and Performance Marketing teams to identify priorities and develop coordinated go-to-market programs.
  • Define regional positioning and messaging that connects Addepar’s global value proposition to the needs of prospective buyers and existing clients.
  • Adapt broader product launches for regional audiences and product availability, while owning end-to-end launches for region-specific capabilities.
  • Develop campaigns that generate awareness and demand among prospects while supporting engagement, adoption and expansion among clients.
  • Create scalable content and enablement, monitor program performance and use market and stakeholder feedback to continually strengthen our approach.

Who You Are

  • 5–8 years of product marketing or related go-to-market experience. Experience with B2B SaaS, financial services, fintech, wealth management or investment management is preferred.
  • Full-stack product marketer with experience across market research, positioning, messaging, launches, campaigns, enablement and content.
  • Experience adapting go-to-market strategies for different markets, audiences or customer needs; direct experience in every region is not required.
  • Excellent storyteller, writer and communicator who can translate sophisticated capabilities into clear customer value.
  • Strong cross-functional partner who can build trusted relationships with regional Sales, Marketing, Relationship Management and Product teams.
  • Globally minded and curious, with the judgment to balance a consistent global narrative with meaningful regional differences.
  • Comfortable working independently across multiple priorities, collaborating across time zones and traveling internationally as needed.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. title: Senior Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Security Team 👋

Our Security team is dedicated to designing, implementing and monitoring the controls that keep Trainline resilient in a fast-evolving threat landscape. As part of our ongoing mission to mature Trainline's security capabilities, you'll help protect the digital channels that power billions of pounds in annual ticket sales, keeping our systems secure, resilient and ready for what's next.

As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you'll take ownership of product security across the development lifecycle, working closely with teams such as SRE and Platform Engineering to embed the latest tools and best practices into everything we build. You'll act as a trusted bridge between security, engineering and the wider business, helping to shape a culture where secure by design is second nature.

In this role as the Senior Product Security Engineer, you will... 🚄

  • Define and own the product security roadmap, aligning priorities with business goals and influencing engineering leadership to embed security into how we design, build and deploy products

  • Establish and own the application security vulnerability management process, from triage and prioritisation through to remediation tracking, setting and reporting metrics such as mean time to remediate (MTTR) by severity and security testing coverage to give leadership clear visibility of risk

  • Work with teams across the business to carry out threat modelling for our web, mobile and API services, identifying risks and putting effective countermeasures in place

  • Assess the security posture of our applications and APIs through code reviews and static and dynamic security testing (SAST/DAST), and manage third-party penetration tests, from scoping with engineering teams and architects through to tracking remediation

  • Strengthen the security of our iOS and Android apps and the APIs that power them, covering areas such as authentication and authorisation, secure data storage, API gateway controls and protection against abuse and automated attacks

  • Implement, maintain and automate the security tools that support safe development and operations, from vulnerability scanning through to application security posture management (ASPM), and partner with engineering teams to fix vulnerabilities in ways that prevent them recurring

  • Build secure coding and deployment knowledge across the organisation through training and mentoring, including helping to establish and grow a security champions programme within our engineering teams

  • Ensure our product security practices align with relevant frameworks and standards, such as OWASP, NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR and PCI DSS, supporting compliance and audit efforts while monitoring emerging threats and finding ways to strengthen our resilience

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience identifying, assessing and mitigating security risks across application design, code and deployed products, including setting up and running application security vulnerability management processes and reporting

  • Experience shaping and delivering a product or application security roadmap, with the confidence to influence engineering leaders and use metrics to demonstrate progress and risk reduction

  • Experience securing mobile applications and APIs, including testing iOS and Android apps and applying secure approaches to authentication and authorisation, such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect

  • Hands-on experience with security testing tools such as SAST, DAST and vulnerability scanning solutions, ideally including mobile app security testing and API security testing tools

  • Practical experience with threat modelling and security reviews, as well as scoping and managing third-party penetration tests in partnership with engineering teams and architects

  • A strong grasp of secure coding practices and experience embedding security into software development workflows, including implementing technical controls and driving automation within CI/CD pipelines, ideally across cloud-native, containerised and infrastructure as code (IaC) environments

  • Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks such as OWASP (ideally including the Mobile Application Security Verification Standard and API Security Top 10), PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and GDPR

  • It would also be helpful if you have experience setting up or growing a security champions programme, running risk assessments, or a working knowledge of regulatory compliance standards

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor! 

Compensation: £90K – £100K

title: Senior Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Taurus

Do you want to be part of a new entrepreneurial adventure and help build the next global FinTech? Then we might just have the job for you.

Taurus is a FINMA-regulated securities firm, headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, and a leading European provider of digital asset infrastructure solutions for banks, broker-dealers, corporates, and private companies. Using blockchain technology, our platform covers cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities and assets, digital currencies, and stablecoins. We are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to support our fast global growth.

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Project Manager to join our Project & Organization team. You will play a central role in managing high-impact projects — from the implementation of our platform within financial institutions to strategic cross-functional initiatives. Working closely with both clients and internal teams, you will help deliver a seamless, high-quality experience while contributing directly to Taurus's continued growth.

This role sits at the intersection of business, technology, and digital assets — ideal for someone eager to grow in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are looking for a resourceful, forward-thinking, and hands-on professional capable of driving strategic planning, operational execution, and client delivery in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Main Responsibilities

  • Client-Facing Project Management: Lead end-to-end delivery projects for our clients (financial institutions, issuers, or LP/market makers). This includes designing operating models and workflows, setting up custody and tokenization platforms, and managing technical implementations in close collaboration with client teams and Taurus' Engineering and Security departments.

  • Internal Strategy & Operations: Deliver cross-functional projects sponsored by the Executive Committee, working across Product, Operations, Compliance, Technology, and Sales. Typical assignments involve regulatory filings, business requirement specifications, operational improvements, and international expansion

  • Blockchain Forensics & Due Diligence: Produce high-quality source-of-funds analyses, wallet screening, and crypto due diligence reports using blockchain intelligence tools to support compliance reviews, onboarding, and investigations.

  • Commercial & Operational Support: Contribute to sales RFPs/RFIs, support ad-hoc commercial or operational priorities across the company.

Requirements

Your Profile

  • Master's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Technology, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in a top-tier consulting firm or in project management within a financial services or fintech environment.

  • Solid understanding of blockchain, cryptocurrencies, and the broader digital asset ecosystem (custody, trading, tokenization, staking, derivatives, etc.).

  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver with a high level of attention to detail.

  • Precise, organized, autonomous, open-minded, hands-on, and results-oriented — a true self-starter and fast learner.

  • Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Willingness to travel to client locations as required

Benefits

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to work at the intersection of digital assets and traditional finance, with direct exposure to leading financial institutions.

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts in digital assets and blockchain.

  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial learning environment with strong team spirit.

  • A great moment to join as Taurus grows and expands globally

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. There will be growth opportunities for candidates with an open mindset and a strong delivery track record. We are an equal opportunity employer.

Note

We will only consider direct applications and won't consider applications submitted via recruitment agencies.

Als Senior Project Manager Digital (m/w/d) in Hamburg oder Berlin gestaltest du moderne Marketing-Asset-Produktionen für nationale und globale Kund*innen – effizient, skalierbar und zukunftssicher.   • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung für eine produktive Umgebung

title: Senior Requirements Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Requirements Engineer (all genders) to join our Central Engineering team and lead requirements engineering practices for the Microliner aircraft.

You will establish and maintain a consistent, traceable, and certification-compliant requirements framework across the aircraft development lifecycle. Working closely with Overall Aircraft Design, Safety, Verification and Validation and Configuration Management, you will enable system and discipline owners to develop high-quality requirements by providing requirements engineering expertise, guidance and quality assurance.

As a senior member of Central Engineering, you will provide requirements engineering expertise across the organization, guide requirement owners in applying effective methods, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead requirements engineering practices across the aircraft development lifecycle, from stakeholder needs and requirements definition through baselining, change management, and certification support.

  • Support aircraft, system, and discipline owners in developing and maintaining clear, consistent, implementation-appropriate, and verifiable requirements, providing expert guidance and quality assurance throughout the process.

  • Support requirement owners in the decomposition and allocation of requirements, and maintain bidirectional traceability across aircraft functions, systems, and engineering disciplines, including requirements applicability and consistency across aircraft variants and configurations.

  • Ensure alignment between requirements, aircraft architecture, interfaces, certification requirements, and safety objectives, and collaborate with the V&V team to establish complete and traceable verification coverage.

  • Facilitate requirements elicitation, development, and review activities, and challenge and support requirement owners in resolving ambiguities, inconsistencies, gaps, and quality issues.

  • Coordinate requirements baselining and change control, including the assessment of impacts on architecture, interfaces, safety, certification, and downstream requirements.

  • Define and continuously improve requirements engineering processes, methods, templates, quality criteria, and tool usage.

  • Assess and communicate requirements maturity, quality, traceability, applicability, and change status in collaboration with the respective requirement owners.

  • Coach engineers and technical leads in requirements development and management best practices.

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.

  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience in requirements and systems engineering, with demonstrated expertise in developing and managing complex requirements throughout the full product development lifecycle and across multiple levels of the requirements hierarchy. Experience with aircraft requirements is preferred; comparable experience from another safety-critical industry, such as automotive, is also considered.

  • Previous experience with the development of novel aircraft systems, such as high-voltage electric propulsion systems, is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience working across a complete requirements hierarchy, from aircraft, vehicle, or product level through system and subsystem levels to hardware and software requirements, including decomposition, allocation, traceability, and management of requirements across organizational and technical boundaries.

title: Senior Research Scientist, AI Safety and Biosecurity
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Basecamp Research is building frontier AI for therapeutic design. We believe the future of medicine lies in reprogramming the body to repair itself, and we design the models and the medicines to teach it how.

Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development.

In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100.

At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today.

The Role

You will advance our work on AI safety and biosecurity, studying the capabilities and risks of biological AI systems and developing methods to evaluate them and make them safer.

We train frontier biological models on BaseData, which captures genetic diversity beyond what is available in public databases. You will work within the team that develops these models, with access to the data, training process, and biological expertise needed to study their capabilities and test safeguards.

You will build on our existing safety work and help set research priorities as our models develop. Depending on your expertise, your work could include:

  • Designing evaluations and red-teaming studies that measure what biological AI systems enable in practice, including how much they add to existing tools and expertise.

  • Developing threat models grounded in biology, and working with experimental scientists to establish when computational results support conclusions about real-world capabilities or risk.

  • Investigating model behaviour, representations, and generalisation to understand where safety evaluations and safeguards hold up or fail.

  • Developing and testing safeguards across training, model behaviour, design screening, and access, measuring both their effectiveness and their effect on useful scientific work.

We will shape the research focus together around your strengths and the problems that matter most. You will lead projects from the initial question through to experiments and methods that the team can use. Your findings will inform how we develop our models and what we publish, release, and offer through our services. You will also have scope to publish research where appropriate and collaborate with the wider AI safety and biosecurity community.

You will report to the Head of AI Research and work alongside researchers in genomics, sequence modelling, and large-scale deep learning, as well as computational biologists and

experimental teams across the company.

About You

You have a strong record of original research in machine learning, AI safety, computational biology, biosecurity, or a closely related field. We want to see work that has advanced understanding or changed research practice: influential papers, research tools used by others, evaluations adopted by other teams, or methods that changed how a system was built or deployed.

You bring deep expertise in a relevant area, such as model evaluation, interpretability, robustness, safeguards, biological modelling, or quantitative assessment of biological risk. You understand modern machine learning and can write the code, run the experiments, and analyse the results needed to test your ideas.

You have a PhD in a relevant field or an equivalent research record, and have led substantial research projects. You can explain your own contribution, the choices you made, and what you learned when an approach did not work.

You are curious about biology and willing to learn its details, whether you already work on biological AI or bring methods from another domain. You work closely with domain experts and recognise when a model score is insufficient evidence for a biological claim.

You exercise good judgement under uncertainty. You design experiments with appropriate controls, look for alternative explanations, and communicate findings and limitations clearly enough for others to act on them.

You work well in a small research team: sharing credit, taking criticism seriously, and helping colleagues solve problems outside your immediate project. You care about enabling useful scientific and medical applications of AI and are motivated to make them safer.

Nice to Have

  • Research experience in AI safety or biosecurity, including evaluations, red-teaming, or threat modelling.

  • Experience with protein design, genomic models, structure prediction, or other biological AI systems.

  • Experimental biology experience, or computational research validated in collaboration with an experimental team.

  • Experience implementing and evaluating safeguards in deployed systems.

  • Collaboration with biosecurity organisations, synthesis screening initiatives, or AI safety institutes.

Compensation and benefits

What we offer in return

  • Impactful Mission: This is a rare chance to do work that genuinely matters. You'll join a talented, fast-moving team, access unique biological datasets at scale, and see your contributions shape real breakthroughs in AI and curative therapeutics..

  • Collaborative Culture: You'll be surrounded by world-class engineers, scientists, and researchers who care deeply about their work and about each other. With offices in London and Boston, we've built a flexible, cross-functional environment where personal development and real ownership aren't just talking points.

  • High Growth: We truly believe in investing our people we make coaching available to team members during steep growth journeys and we have twice yearly promotion opportunities. People who are really successful here own it and go directly to solve problems at pace and we ensure reward increases with impact.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We've built a benefits package people value. That means competitive salary, equity, and private healthcare with no medical history exclusions so strong that means most employees' family members opt into our plan over their own. We also offer Carrot Fertility with IVF stipend, salary sacrifice pension, bike to work scheme, life insurance, and more.

We are committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of ethnic or national origin, race, religion, sex, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, gender identity or any other basis. If you have a disability or additional need that needs accommodating do let us know.

title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Payload Integration

descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maneuver Dominance team at Anduril develops operationally relevant, multi-asset autonomy. We are focused on making large groups of autonomous systems work effectively together. We leverage existing Anduril drone platforms like Ghost or Altius, in addition to bringing 3rd party platforms into Anduril’s Lattice ecosystem. 

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior Robotics Software Engineer, Omen Payload Integration to join the Maneuver Dominance team in Abu Dhabi (UAE). In this role, you will design, develop, and integrate software that connects autonomous platforms with mission payloads, including stores management systems (SMS), networked devices, and hardware interfaces. You will architect APIs and data transport layers that move information reliably between vehicles, payloads, and ground systems in demanding operational environments.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of software, networking, and hardware, and are passionate about delivering mission-critical systems, this opportunity is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop Networked Software: Engineer scalable, robust software that interacts with networking devices, managed networks, and common router or switch hardware.
  • Payload & SMS Integration: Design and implement software that interfaces with stores management systems (SMS) and other payload subsystems to coordinate the release and control of munitions and mission payloads.
  • API/ICD Design: Architect and implement software APIs and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) using HTTP, REST, and gRPC to connect distributed systems across vehicles, payloads, and ground stations.
  • Data Transport Engineering: Build and optimize low-level data transport over UDP and TCP, ensuring reliable, low-latency communication in constrained operational environments.
  • Hardware-Interfacing Software: Write code that interfaces directly with hardware, bridging embedded devices, sensors, and payload electronics with higher-level autonomy software.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with hardware, systems, vehicle, and payload teams to seamlessly integrate software into physical platforms.
  • Real-World Deployment: Travel up to 25% to test, debug, and deploy systems in operational environments.
  • Iterative Development: Contribute across the entire software lifecycle, including prototyping, implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Troubleshoot and Debug: Analyze and resolve issues in deployed systems, ensuring reliability and operational success.

Required Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • C++ or Rust Proficiency: 5+ years of hands-on experience developing production-grade software in C++ and/or Rust. Strong programmers in adjacent systems languages will be considered if other qualifications are met.
  • Networking Software: Experience building software that interacts with networking devices, managed networks, and common router or switch hardware.
  • API/ICD Design: Experience designing and implementing software APIs and ICDs, including work with HTTP, REST, and gRPC.
  • Data Transport: Solid understanding of low-level data transport layers, including UDP and TCP.
  • Hardware Interfacing: Experience writing code that interfaces with hardware (embedded devices, sensors, or payload electronics).
  • Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to navigate and contribute to complex systems and established codebases.
  • Real-World Impact: Passion for building software that directly influences mission-critical outcomes.
  • Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel up to 50% to test and deploy systems.
  • Global Operations: Experience working with international suppliers and customers in the EMEA region.
  • Security Clearance: Must be able to obtain a Secret Clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Stores Management Systems: Direct experience with stores management systems (SMS) or related munitions/payload release systems in aerospace or defense platforms.
  • Aerospace/Defense Background: Familiarity with aerospace integration standards, vehicle bus protocols (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, ARINC), or DO-178/DO-254 development practices.
  • Distributed Systems: Experience designing fault-tolerant distributed systems and message-passing frameworks for multi-node coordination.
  • Embedded & Real-Time Systems: Experience with embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal development on resource-constrained hardware.
  • Programming Skills: Additional experience with Python, Go, or scripting for tooling and test automation.
  • Performance Optimization: Familiarity with profiling and optimizing networked and hardware-interfacing software.

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. As Senior Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll lead, coach and develop a team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers in the UK. You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from qualification through close, including discovery, value selling, negotiation, objection handling and close planning.

  • Strong practical knowledge of MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology, with the ability to train, inspect and reinforce its use across a team.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing pipeline, inspecting opportunities, forecasting accurately and maintaining disciplined CRM standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including providing clear feedback and addressing under-performance fairly and effectively.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments or financial services, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • Experience selling multi-product fintech or payments solutions, such as payments, foreign exchange, business accounts, cards or spend management, to founders, CFOs, Finance, Operations or business-owner stakeholders.

  • Experience building or scaling a sales team, market, outbound motion or go-to-market strategy in the UK, EMEA or another developing market.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and modern sales tools such as Gong, Chorus, Outreach, Salesloft or AI-enabled sales platforms, together with an interest in using data and technology to improve sales productivity.

You'll thrive here if

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You take feedback well and actively seek it. You see it as a tool, not a criticism.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

title: Senior Scrum Master
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

  • Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
  • Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
  • Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
  • Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
  • Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
  • A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
  • Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
  • A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
  • A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.
  • A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.
  • Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range£48,000—£80,000 GBP

title: Senior Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be the primary software point of contact for the Laser team and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and experimental-system interfaces. You will help define the architecture and technology direction for a greenfield laser-software platform while remaining hands-on in developing reliable tools for calibration, operation, human-machine interaction, and experimental data processing.

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. You will help shape technical direction, establish the foundations of a new software platform, and grow toward a broader technical leadership role. The position does not initially include direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary software partner for the Laser team and coordinate software activities across laser projects.

  • Provide technical leadership for software initiatives, including planning, technical alignment, risk identification, and coordination with laser physicists, engineers, and systems-integration partners.

  • Help define the architecture, technology choices, development practices, and interfaces for a new laser-software platform in a greenfield environment.

  • Design and implement reliable software for critical laser projects, from system-level interfaces to user-facing applications.

  • Develop and maintain automated calibration software that improves repeatability, reduces manual effort, and supports reliable laser operation.

  • Design and build clear, dependable human-machine interfaces, dashboards, and operational tools for monitoring and operating laser systems.

  • Develop software that interfaces with laser devices, diagnostic systems, cameras, and experimental equipment to support data acquisition, system monitoring, operational control, and visualization.

  • Develop data-processing pipelines and data-storage solutions for experimental and operational data, including diagnostic and camera data where appropriate.

  • Define robust interfaces between software, hardware, cameras, and experimental systems in an environment where requirements and technologies are still evolving.

  • Work with networked device and system interfaces, potentially including TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable communication technologies.

  • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and operational guidance to support long-term maintainability and safe, reliable operation.

  • Identify and address reliability, performance, integration, debugging, and maintenance risks in software that interacts with real-world systems.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the Software Department.

  • Mentor engineers and help establish engineering practices as the software team grows.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous technical problems and building systems from the ground up.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of technical direction while collaborating closely with software specialists, laser physicists, experimental experts, and systems-integration partners.

  • You can move effectively between technical leadership, project coordination, architecture, and hands-on implementation.

  • You take ownership of the quality, reliability, testability, and long-term maintainability of the systems you build.

  • You communicate clearly with both software specialists and technical partners from adjacent disciplines.

  • You apply sound technical judgment when making design, implementation, and technology-selection decisions in an evolving environment.

  • You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand how software interacts with hardware, cameras, diagnostics, and experimental systems.

  • You are experienced in debugging and testing complex software and understand their importance in senior-level engineering work.

  • You value constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers.

  • You are interested in developing toward technical leadership and project ownership. Formal people-management responsibility is not required at the outset.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Python, or comparable programming languages.

  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

  • Knowledge of software architecture, code review practices, automated testing, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Experience with greenfield development, platform or architecture definition, and making technology choices where requirements are still evolving.

  • Experience with automated calibration, control-adjacent software, laboratory systems, automation, or physical-device interfaces.

  • Experience developing human-machine interfaces, dashboards, or software for operating technical equipment.

  • Experience with camera integration, image processing, diagnostic data, or experimental data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience developing data-storage solutions for high-volume, time-series, experimental, or operational data.

  • Familiarity with software-hardware integration and working across experimental-system boundaries.

  • Experience with networked device communication or system interfaces, such as TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with control systems or optics is beneficial, but not required; the ability to learn and collaborate across these disciplines is more important.

  • Previous experience mentoring engineers or leading technical design discussions.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data & AI Platform (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Redefine the future of live entertainment tech
Welcome to vivenu, the global leader in event ticketing tech and one of the world’s fastest-growing live entertainment tech firms. We are transforming event ticketing for global leaders like the Grammys, the Golden Globes, Stanford University and the Hockenheimring turning what was once a simple transaction into a strategic business advantage. Backed by over $65 million in funding, our platform empowers event organizers to own their brand experience, unlock deep data insights, and seamlessly integrate ticketing into their digital infrastructure.
With six offices worldwide and growing, we deliver a customizable, intuitive solution and industry-leading support that simplify even the most complex ticketing challenges – helping organizers deliver exceptional experiences and drive real growth.
Join us and build the future of live entertainment.
With over 10 million end users and usage quadrupling annually, our infrastructure now handles over 1 billion requests per month — and counting. Our API-first platform solves complex system challenges at scale — delivering performance, flexibility, and reliability for the world’s leading live entertainment brands.
As a Senior Software Engineer - Data & AI Platform (d/f/m) your responsibilities will include:

Your Responsibilities:

  • Build Analytical Query Engines:Connect our transactional backends (MongoDB) with modern analytical event stores (ClickHouse) to support sub-second aggregations across millions of ticket transactions.

  • Implement AI Retrieval & Reporting Workflows: Build and deploy Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic parsers, and agentic query supervisors that convert natural language prompts into deterministic, accurate SQL and aggregation queries.

  • Maintain Low-Latency Reporting APIs: Write high-performance production services in Go or TypeScript/Node.js that power real-time reporting dashboards for global organizers without degrading transactional processing.

  • Centralize Data Flows & Auditing: Partner with platform and security teams to build clean data schemas, strict audit trails, and automated evaluation suites that catch hallucinated data or metric drifts before they reach clients.

  • Sprint Scoping & Architecture: Collaborate directly in monthly in-person architecture sessions in Frankfurt alongside the VP of Engineering, CTO, and engineering leads to define technical milestones.


    • What you will need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experiencebuilding high-throughput, distributed production services using Go, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js.

  • Analytical Warehousing Experience:Direct, hands-on production experience with ClickHouse (or closely related low-latency analytical engines like DuckDB, Snowflake, or Apache Pinot) for high-volume event streams.

  • Database Mastery: Solid practical experience with both document/NoSQL stores (MongoDB) and relational engines (PostgreSQL).

  • Production AI / RAG Engineering: Proven experience deploying production RAG systems, function calling, evaluation frameworks, and supervisor architectures (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration layers).

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Strong understanding of distributed message streaming using Kafka, RabbitMQ, or cloud pub/sub mechanisms.

  • Pragmatic Mindset: High autonomy and scrappiness—you choose reliable, deterministic validation layers and battle-tested databases over fragile AI hype.

    Live Entertainment TechPlay a mission-critical role for global brands, redefining fan experiences from festivals to major sports events. Here, you’re part of the business of fun — powered by cutting-edge technology that brings moments to life for millions.
    Sustainable GrowthWe scale sustainably on a profitable, VC-backed foundation with true product-market fit. This means continuous investment in our people, products, and long-term vision.
    Top-tier TeamCollaborate with over 160 dedicated professionals, including leaders from Google, Slack, and Salesforce. Together, we’re shaping the future of live entertainment technology, one decision at a time.
    Global DNAWe’re a diverse, merit-driven team spread across six global offices. Talent and impact are what matter here — not hierarchy or background.
    Fast Growing, in All AspectsSifted consistently ranks us among the fastest-growing scale-ups in Europe. We’re driven by daily learning, shared wins, and collective growth.
    Next-Gen Leaders & InsightsWork alongside some of tech’s brightest minds — from Forbes 30 Under 30 founders to Executive of the Year award winners. At vivenu, you’ll help set the standard for the ticketing industry’s future.
    vivenu Inclusion StatementAt vivenu, we believe our people define our success – and that we win with bold, diverse minds. The strongest teams are built on different perspectives, experiences, and voices. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to contribute, grow, and thrive to shape the future of live entertainment globally.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America.

What you will do

  • Design and build core low-level services and distributed runtimes for Nubank’s global data platform, with high fault tolerance, elastic scale and sub-second event availability.

  • Lead the design of compute orchestration frameworks on large Kubernetes clusters, improving scheduling throughput and resource utilization for complex data pipelines.

  • Design and optimize high-throughput streaming and storage architectures using Apache Kafka and distributed database internals for mission-critical financial workloads.

  • Find and remove performance, network and storage bottlenecks across the infrastructure stack to reduce latency.

  • Work with Analytics Engineering leads and platform users to define internal APIs, developer toolchains and data modeling practices that speed up developers company-wide.

  • Set standards for resilience testing, automated failover, observability and architectural documentation.

What you bring

  • Substantial experience designing, scaling and operating mission-critical distributed systems and backend architectures in high-throughput production environments.

  • Strong practical knowledge of container orchestration and systems management at scale, ideally Kubernetes internals and custom controllers or operators.

  • Advanced proficiency in a systems-oriented language such as Go, Java, Scala, Rust or C++.

  • Experience with database system architecture (storage engines, indexing, replication) and/or event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

  • A track record of technical leadership: writing design proposals, aligning teams on complex technical decisions, and mentoring engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms, custom compute engines or low-level database products.

  • Experience with data platforms or compute runtimes that support production AI/ML training and inference.

  • Familiarity with multi-region AWS networking, security, IAM and compute.

  • Involvement in open-source distributed systems projects (e.g. Kubernetes, Kafka, data orchestration).

What we offer
We offer a competitive base salary in line with market rates, depending on experience and skills, along with:

  • Learning and wellness allowance

  • Vacations of 28 working days

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

Work Model
Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

Build software that matters. Shape the future of engineering.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer - Java, React & AWS who is passionate about building scalable, high-quality software and helping teams grow. This is more than a hands-on engineering role. You’ll influence technical direction, mentor other engineers, drive architectural decisions, and help us embed AI and automation into the way we deliver value for our clients.

You’ll thrive here if you enjoy solving complex problems, challenging assumptions, collaborating openly, and taking pride in delivering software that makes a real business impact.

Our Tech:

You’ll have strong commercial experience with:

  • Modern Java (Java 8+) including Streams, Lambdas and Optional
  • Spring Boot and the wider Spring ecosystem
  • React, including hooks, component design and state management
  • JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Spring Data JPA / Hibernate
  • Spring Security including OAuth2 and JWT
  • REST API design and implementation
  • Microservices and distributed system design
  • SQL databases with strong query optimisation skills
  • NoSQL databases
  • Messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Docker and containerised application development
  • CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI
  • Git and modern software development workflows
  • Observability tooling including logging, metrics and distributed tracing
  • Comprehensive testing across unit, integration and functional layers, including front-end testing with tools such as Jest and React Testing Library
  • Maven or Gradle
  • Java concurrency and JVM performance fundamentals

AWS

You’ll have hands-on experience building and running production workloads on AWS, including:

  • AWS Lambda: designing event-driven, serverless functions triggered from API Gateway, S3, SQS or EventBridge, including running Java on Lambda and reducing cold starts (for example with SnapStart)
  • Amazon S3: bucket design, access control, lifecycle policies and event notifications
  • Amazon RDS (PostgreSQL or MySQL): connection management, read replicas, backup and restore, and performance tuning
  • Amazon CloudWatch: structured logging, custom metrics, dashboards and alarms, and using Logs Insights to diagnose production issues
